Description:
**Req Id:**

Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.
  
  
We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell.
  
  
On the Bell Business Markets team, you’ll be a vital part of making innovation happen for enterprise-scale customers. You’ll deliver advanced solutions in areas such as IoT, Mobility/5G, Cloud, Cyber Security, Voice, Collaboration & Contact Centre and Internet & Private Networks.
  
  
At Bell, your skills and expertise will help set us apart as we continue to be the leading provider of digital connections and next generation services to businesses and governments.
  
  
**Summary**
Within the Bell Canada Business Market Enterprise segment, Managed Services has the overall accountability to support our customers with Day 2 activities.
  
  
The Incident and Change Manager is accountable to provide pro-active or re-active solutions for all the different aspects of problems ‘related to customers’. Our business model is highly customer-centric, with shared accountability between Service teams for managing customer issues. This seamless approach to customer service has been a key factor in achieving Industry-leading levels of customer satisfaction. Our business strategy going forward is to leverage this strong base of customer loyalty and our stream of new IP & Value Added Services. The Incident and Change Manager plays a key role and is an integral part of the end-to-end solution.
  
  
Eligible candidates must have a strong technical background and in depth knowledge in troubleshooting VOIP and IP data networks. Knowledge of legacy voice and data technologies would also be beneficial.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the single point of contact for all customer escalations and service assurance related issues
* Available 7/24 for escalations
* Provide communications to customers, internal business groups and executives during major incidents
* Lead major incidents through their lifecycle in order to meet expected SLA / SLOs up to resolution
* Ability to provide leadership and technical guidance on Major Incident conference calls
* Produce and Review Post Mortem Reports in a timely manner
* Collaborate with stakeholders to identify, assess, and prioritize device change requests
* Develop and implement change management plans, ensuring compliance with ITIL guidelines and best practices
* Facilitate and oversee the execution of device changes, coordinating with technical teams to ensure minimal disruption to services
* Analyze post-change outcomes, conducting root cause analysis of failed changes and identifying opportunities for improvement
* Monitor and ensure ticket compliancy, addressing any deviations or non-conformances
* Provide regular status updates to senior management and key stakeholders
* Responsible to implement solutions to improve the customer experience and provide proactive approaches to eliminate problematic trends
* Facilitate governance meetings with various partners (Help Desk, Network & Field Services)
* Ensure quality control on Problem/Incident activities
* Meet with Customer Service Account Managers on a regular basis to present results and action plans related to Problem Management activities
* Identify service improvement opportunities and analyze Risk Assessments

**Critical Qualifications**

* Preferred Electrical Engineering / Computer Sciences degree or equivalent
* 3 years or more industry experience
* In-depth knowledge of telecommunications industry; More specifically in the following fields:

- Managed Services (Voice and Data)
- VoIP
- LAN/WAN technologies
- Applications (e-mail, client-server applications… etc.)
- Security Solutions
- Data Centers

* Knowledge and training required:

- ITIL Foundation
- Preferred Certification training in Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Juniper, F5, and similar Network Vendors
- MicroStrategy
- Microsoft Office products

Adequate knowledge of French is required for positions in Quebec.

Tout part d’une connexion. Elle nous pousse à innover, à explorer et à rester proches de ce qui compte le plus pour nous. Chez Bell, nous bâtissons un avenir plus connecté grâce à des réseaux de calibre mondial, à des solutions propulsées par l’IA et à des expériences numériques qui améliorent la façon dont les gens vivent, travaillent et se divertissent chaque jour.
  
  
Nous croyons à l’autonomisation de chacun. C’est pourquoi nous dotons nos équipes d’une technologie de pointe, d’outils d’IA et d’un environnement collaboratif qui soutient la créativité et la croissance. Voulez-vous faire partie d’une équipe diversifiée où votre travail a un réel impact? Si vous êtes inspiré par l’innovation qui fait progresser la façon dont les gens se connectent et transforme ce qui est possible, vous avez votre place au sein de l’#ÉquipeBell.
  
  
Au sein de l’équipe Bell Marchés Affaires, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel en matière d’innovation pour notre clientèle d’entreprises. Vous livrerez des solutions évoluées dans des domaines comme l’Internet des objets, la mobilité et la 5G, l’infonuagique, la cybersécurité, les services vocaux, la collaboration et les centres de contact, ainsi que l’Internet et les réseaux privés.
  
  
Vos compétences et votre expertise aideront Bell à se démarquer alors que nous restons le premier fournisseur de connexions numériques et de services de prochaine génération pour les entreprises et les gouvernements.
  
  
**Résumé**
Au sein du segment des grandes entreprises de Bell Marchés Affaires de Bell Canada, l’équipe Services gérés est entièrement responsable du soutien de nos clients ayant des activités de soutien du jour 2.
  
  
Le gestionnaire des incidents et des changements est responsable de fournir des solutions proactives ou réactives afin d’empêcher ou de régler tous les différents aspects de problèmes « liés aux clients ». Notre modèle d’affaires est axé sur le client et prévoit un partage des responsabilités entre les équipes de service, en ce qui a trait à la gestion des problèmes des clients. Cette approche transparente du service à la clientèle est un facteur clé pour atteindre les niveaux les plus élevés de l’industrie en matière de satisfaction de la clientèle. Dorénavant, notre stratégie d’affaires est de miser sur cette base solide de clientèle fidèle et sur la promotion de notre gamme de nouveaux services IP et services à valeur ajoutée. Le gestionnaire des incidents et des changements joue un rôle très important et il fait partie intégrante de la solution de bout en bout.
  
  
Le candidat éligible doit avoir une solide formation technique et des connaissances approfondies en matière de dépannage des réseaux de données VOIP et IP. La connaissance des anciennes technologies de la voix et les réseaux de données serait également utile.
  
  
**Principales responsabilités**

* Agir à titre de point de contact unique pour toutes les escalades des clients et les problèmes d’assurance du service.
* Disponible 7 / 24 pour escalades.
* Assurer la communication avec les clients, les groupes d'affaires internes et les exécutifs lors d'incidents majeurs.
* Diriger les incidents majeurs jusqu’à leur résolution afin de respecter les indicateurs attendus (EQS, OQS).
* Fournir du leadership et des conseils techniques dans le cadre de conférences téléphoniques au sujet d’incidents graves.
* Produire et passer en revue des analyses rétrospectives en temps opportun.
* Faciliter l'exhaustivité, l'exactitude et la conformité de tous les actifs et de toutes les configurations dans la CMDB en effectuant des audits réguliers et en veillant au respect des normes établies.
* Superviser et maintenir l'exactitude et l'intégrité de la CMDB, y compris l'identification, la classification et la catégorisation de tous les actifs et de toutes les configurations au sein de l'organisation.
* Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles, notamment les opérations informatiques, la prestation de services et les unités commerciales, pour recueillir et valider les données relatives aux actifs et aux configurations, en veillant à leur exactitude et à leur exhaustivité.
* Développer et mettre en œuvre des processus et des procédures pour la gestion efficace des actifs et des configurations, y compris la gestion des changements, la gestion des incidents et la gestion des problèmes.
* Effectuer des examens réguliers des données relatives aux actifs et aux configurations afin d'identifier et de corriger toute divergence ou lacune, en veillant à ce que la CMDB reste à jour et fiable.
* Analyser les données relatives aux actifs et aux configurations afin d'identifier les tendances, les modèles et les possibilités d'amélioration des processus, et recommander des améliorations pour optimiser les pratiques de gestion des actifs et des configurations.
* Assumer la responsabilité des solutions visant à améliorer l’expérience client et faire preuve d’une approche proactive afin d’éliminer des tendances problématiques.
* Animer des réunions concernant la gouvernance avec différents partenaires (équipes Centre d’assistance, Réseau et Services extérieurs).
* Assurer le contrôle de la qualité des activités de gestion des problèmes et des incidents.
* Rencontrer régulièrement les gestionnaires de comptes clients pour présenter les résultats et les plans d’action liés à la gestion des problèmes.
* Déterminer les possibilités d’amélioration du service et analyser les évaluations des risques.

**Qualifications Essentielles**

* Diplôme en génie électrique, en informatique ou l’équivalent, souhaité
* Au moins trois ans d’expérience dans l’industrie
* Excellente connaissance du secteur des télécommunications, notamment des domaines suivants :

- Services gérés (voix et données)
- Voix sur IP (VoIP)
- Technologies de réseau local et de réseau étendu
- Applications (courriel, applications client-serveur, etc.)
- Solutions de sécurité
- Centres de données

* Connaissances et formation requises :

- Connaissance des principes fondamentaux de l’ITIL
- Formation en certification de Cisco, Fortinet, Juniper, Palo Alto, F5 et fournisseurs réseau similaires souhaitée
- Connaissance de l’application MicroStrategy
- Connaissance des produits Microsoft Office

* Develop strategies to identify and capture add on sales and upselling opportunities across portfolio.

* Ensure risk, compliance, and quality management standards are maintained across all engagements.

* At least 8 years in program or project management
* Presales and service delivery experience with accountability for end-to-end programs.

Title: Director Customer Operations
Description:
**Join our Team**
**Location:**
Canada – Toronto.
  
  
At this time, Ericsson Canada Inc. does not provide immigration assistance/sponsorship now or in the future for this position.
  
  
**About this opportunity:**
We are seeking a Director of Customer Operations to lead end‑to‑end operational excellence across Cloud Software & Services (CSS) engagements, for one of the leading customers in Canada. This is a CFR (Customer Fulfillment Responsible) role and as part of the Core-3 engagements, expected to lead the fulfillment part through the sale and delivery lifecycle. Reporting to the Head of Operations CSS Canada, the role is accountable for customer delivery performance, operational governance, financial discipline, and cross‑functional execution, ensuring CSS delivers high‑quality outcomes at scale while continuously improving customer experience and profitability.
  
  
The Director of Customer Operations partners closely with Customer Units (CUs), Sales, Delivery, PMO, Product, and Business Operations to translate strategy into execution and drive predictable outcomes for CSS business and customer success.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Own end‑to‑end customer delivery performance across CSS engagements, ensuring delivery commitments, SLAs, and contractual outcomes are met.
* Drive operational rigor across delivery governance, escalation management, risk mitigation, and customer satisfaction.
* Act as the senior operational interface for key customer engagements, working in close partnership with account leadership.
* Lead customer steering meetings for reporting progress on critical programs and tracking key issues, escalations etc.
* Establish and lead operating rhythms, governance forums, and performance reviews across CSS delivery units.
* Monitor operational and financial KPIs including delivery health, margin, forecast accuracy, cost control, and customer experience metrics.
* Identify performance trends and drive corrective actions across portfolios and delivery teams.

Title: Service Management (MSP Governance & ITIL Operations Lead)
Description:
IT Service Management Manager

**MSP Governance | ITIL Operations | Major Incident Management**

**Reports to:**
Director, Technology & Security Operations

**Location:**
Toronto, Ontario (Hybrid – 2 days in-office)

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced IT Service Management Manager to lead Managed Service Provider (MSP) governance, ITSM operations, vendor performance management and continuous service improvement across the enterprise.

This role is accountable for ensuring reliable, high-quality technology services through effective vendor oversight, structured service governance, incident management and operational performance monitoring.

The successful candidate will bring approximately 15 years of overall IT Service Management experience, including at least 5 years in a Service Management Manager or equivalent leadership capacity. They will have the experience and confidence to manage external service providers, establish accountability, oversee service delivery and work effectively with senior technology stakeholders.

Equally important is the ability to adapt to changing business priorities and evolving technology requirements. We are looking for someone who combines strong management experience with a practical, collaborative and hands-on approach.

This is not a traditional service desk management role. It is a governance-focused position requiring strong MSP oversight, vendor accountability, ITIL process management, major incident leadership and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

1. MSP Governance & Vendor Management

* Own and oversee the performance of third-party Managed Service Providers across enterprise IT services.
* Manage vendor performance against contractual obligations, SLAs, KPIs, availability targets, response and resolution times.
* Establish and maintain vendor governance frameworks, performance scorecards, escalation procedures and accountability models.
* Lead monthly and quarterly service reviews with MSPs, identifying service gaps and driving corrective action plans.
* Hold service providers accountable for performance issues, recurring incidents and contractual commitments.
* Build strong relationships with internal technology teams, procurement, business stakeholders and external service providers.
* Identify opportunities to improve vendor performance, service quality, operational efficiency and value for money.

2. IT Service Management & ITIL Governance

* Govern and continuously improve enterprise ITSM processes in alignment with ITIL best practices.
* Oversee Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Asset, Knowledge and Technology Continuity Management.
* Ensure ITSM processes are consistently followed by MSPs and internal technology teams.
* Monitor ticket quality, backlog aging, incident trends, reassignment rates and overall service management effectiveness.
* Establish clear process ownership, RACI frameworks and escalation models.
* Partner with technology leadership to establish meaningful service management KPIs and performance measures.
* Conduct ITSM maturity assessments and identify opportunities to strengthen governance, processes and operational capabilities.

3. Major Incident & Problem Management

* Lead and coordinate Priority 1 and Priority 2 technology incidents, acting as Incident Commander when required.
* Coordinate incident response activities, including war rooms, escalations, stakeholder communications and executive updates.
* Ensure incidents are managed within established response and resolution targets.
* Facilitate Post-Incident Reviews and validate Root Cause Analysis reports provided by service providers.
* Track corrective and preventative actions to minimize recurring incidents.
* Identify systemic service issues and work with vendors to implement sustainable improvements.

4. Change Management & Operational Risk

* Participate in and serve as an approver for the Change Advisory Board (CAB).
* Evaluate proposed changes based on business impact, operational risk, testing, implementation readiness and rollback plans.
* Ensure appropriate change management controls and governance practices are followed.
* Monitor change success rates, unauthorized changes and incidents resulting from production changes.
* Work with technology teams and service providers to minimize operational disruption during technology changes and implementations.

5. Service Performance & Continuous Improvement

* Develop and maintain service performance dashboards and executive-level reporting.
* Translate service management metrics, including MTTR, availability, incident trends, backlog health and change success rates, into meaningful operational and business insights.
* Identify opportunities to improve service delivery, reduce recurring incidents, minimize downtime and enhance the end-user experience.
* Lead continuous service improvement initiatives aligned with organizational priorities.
* Recommend process improvements, automation opportunities and enhancements to service delivery models.
* Partner with senior technology leadership to improve transparency, operational accountability and service performance.

6. ITSM Transformation & Technology Enablement

* Identify opportunities to modernize IT service management through workflow automation, improved self-service capabilities and emerging technologies.
* Support enhancements to ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms.
* Explore AI-enabled ITSM capabilities to improve incident management, knowledge management, service request handling and operational efficiency.
* Work collaboratively with internal teams and service providers to implement practical improvements.
* Adapt service management practices as technology, business requirements and organizational priorities evolve.

7. Disaster Recovery & Technology Continuity

* Support governance and oversight of Disaster Recovery planning and testing activities.
* Validate operational readiness and ensure appropriate continuity procedures are documented and maintained.
* Confirm Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) are aligned with business requirements.
* Ensure continuity runbooks and recovery procedures are tested and validated before high-risk technology initiatives or changes.

Required Experience & Qualifications

* Approximately 15 years of overall experience in IT Service Management, IT Service Delivery or IT Operations.
* **Minimum 5 years of experience specifically in a Service Management Manager**
  or equivalent leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience managing and governing third-party Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and technology service vendors.
* Strong understanding of vendor performance management, contractual obligations, SLAs, KPIs, service delivery and escalation management.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL frameworks, preferably ITIL v4, with practical experience overseeing Incident, Problem and Change Management.
* Demonstrated experience managing major technology incidents, including P1/P2 incident coordination and escalation.
* Experience participating in or leading Change Advisory Boards (CAB) and assessing operational and business risks.
* Proven ability to identify service delivery gaps, challenge vendor performance and implement corrective action plans.
* Experience developing service performance reports, dashboards and operational KPIs for technology leadership.
* Experience conducting ITSM process assessments, identifying improvement opportunities and supporting service transformation initiatives.
* Experience with ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms, including incident workflows, reporting, automation and self-service capabilities.
* Experience supporting hybrid technology environments, including Microsoft 365, Google Cloud Platform and third-party SaaS platforms.
* Experience supporting Disaster Recovery planning, testing and operational readiness activities.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications & Assets

* ITIL v4 Foundation or higher certification.
* Experience working in a complex enterprise technology environment.
* Experience overseeing multiple MSPs or service providers across different technology domains.
* Familiarity with ITSM automation, AI-enabled service management and workflow optimization.
* Experience with service governance frameworks, operational risk management and continuous improvement methodologies.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be an established IT Service Management leader with approximately 15 years of overall ITSM experience and at least 5 years managing service management functions.

They will have the experience to independently manage external service providers, challenge vendor performance, drive accountability and communicate effectively with senior technology stakeholders.

  **.**

  levels
  **.**

Title: Director, IT Infrastructure & Operations
Industry: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage
Description:
**Job Description**
The Director, IT Infrastructure and Operations leads the teams that keep Liquidity Services’ technology operating reliably every day: Platform Operations, Network Engineering, and Service Desk and Field Support. This role is accountable for the reliability, security, scalability, and cost-effectiveness of end-user support; server, identity, collaboration, backup, and storage platforms across on-premises, Azure, and AWS environments; and the hybrid network that connects offices, retail locations, warehouse facilities, cloud environments, and remote users. As a hands-on technical leader, the Director sets operational standards and service levels, serves as the senior escalation point for infrastructure and network issues, builds and develops the team, manages vendors and budgets, and leads modernization efforts in partnership with Information Security, DevOps, application teams, and business leaders. Based in the Dallas area, the Director works on-site at the Richardson, TX office several days a week and serves as the senior IT operations leader for that location.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Service availability: Uptime of critical infrastructure, network, and end-user services meets defined targets.
* Service Desk performance: Response time, resolution time, first-contact resolution, backlog, and employee satisfaction meet agreed service levels.
* Security and compliance: Servers, endpoints, and network devices are kept current on security patches, vulnerabilities are remediated on schedule, and infrastructure controls pass PCI and SOX audits.
* Resilience: Backups and disaster recovery are tested regularly and meet defined recovery goals.
* Modernization delivery: The infrastructure and network roadmap is executed on schedule and within budget, including removing the dependency on Cisco cloud services routers and delivering new facility builds and site upgrades.
* Financial management: Infrastructure, cloud, telecom, and support spending is managed within budget, with measurable licensing, cloud, and vendor cost savings.
* Team strength: Strong retention, development, and coverage of critical skills across all three teams.
* Lead, manage, and develop the Platform Operations, Network Engineering, and Service Desk and Field Support teams, including hiring, goal setting, performance management, coaching, and succession planning.
* Set the strategy and multi-year roadmap for end-user support, infrastructure, and network services, aligned with business priorities, security requirements, and the company’s cloud direction.
* Oversee Service Desk and Field Support operations through the Service Desk Director, including field services across offices, retail locations, and warehouse facilities, and set expectations for service levels, escalation paths, staffing and coverage models, and self-service and knowledge-management practices.
* Own the implementation, delivery, and support of enterprise server and identity platforms, including Windows Server, virtualization platforms, Active Directory, Entra ID (Azure AD), ADFS, and DNS/DHCP.
* Own the Microsoft 365 collaboration stack, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, and Teams, and the endpoint management platforms that support it.
* Oversee cloud infrastructure across multiple Azure regions and the AWS environment, in partnership with DevOps and application teams.
* Own backup and disaster recovery using Rubrik and Azure Site Recovery, including regular recovery testing, documentation, and business continuity planning.
* Govern enterprise file shares and data storage policies, including retention, PII, access, and user roles, with regular access and integrity audits in partnership with Information Security.
* Drive cloud cost optimization with Server, Development, DevOps, and Database teams using native cloud cost tools.
* Oversee the hybrid network environment, including Cisco and Meraki switching and wireless, Palo Alto firewalls and VPN, WAN and internet connectivity, and the program to replace Cisco cloud services routers with cloud-native connectivity between Azure, AWS, and company sites.
* Own infrastructure and network monitoring and alerting (such as PRTG and Datadog), so that issues are detected and resolved before they affect the business.
* Lead IT delivery for new facilities, expansions, relocations, and site upgrades, coordinating network, infrastructure, end-user equipment, and Service Desk readiness.
* Establish and run IT service management processes, including incident, problem, change, configuration, asset, and request management; lead major-incident response and post-incident reviews, and serve as the senior escalation point for infrastructure issues.
* Serve as the primary liaison between Platform Operations and the Security and Site Reliability (SSRE) team; partner with Information Security on patching, vulnerability remediation, access controls, logging, and segmentation, and support PCI, SOX, and other audit and control requirements.
* Define operational metrics and dashboards, and report service performance, risks, and project status to IT leadership and business stakeholders.
* Develop and manage the infrastructure, cloud, network, telecom, and support budgets; drive cost optimization across licensing, cloud consumption, carriers, and hardware.
* Manage relationships with key vendors, carriers, managed service providers, and contractors; partner with the Contracts team on negotiations, renewals, and service-performance reviews.
* Champion automation, standardization, and documentation to improve reliability and reduce manual work.
* Serve as the senior IT infrastructure leader on-site at the Richardson, TX office and as the escalation point for after-hours critical incidents.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Team or Function Manager: This position manages a team or function and is responsible for hiring, performance management, employee development, and ensuring work is completed in alignment with organizational objectives.
* Directly manages the leaders and senior individual contributors responsible for Platform Operations, Network Engineering, and Service Desk and Field Support, including the Service Desk Director who leads help desk and field support technicians.
* Provides second-level leadership for help desk analysts and field support technicians, ensuring consistent service levels, escalation practices, performance expectations, and employee experience across locations.
* Responsible for hiring, performance management, development, and staffing decisions for these teams, and for oversight of contractors and managed service providers supporting these functions.

**Qualifications**
**Education/ Experience**
:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of experience and certifications.
* Ten or more years of progressively responsible IT infrastructure and operations experience, including at least five years managing technical teams.
* Hands-on background in Microsoft server and identity infrastructure, including Windows Server, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365, in an organization with at least 1,000 employees is preferred.
* Experience leading multiple IT functions, such as platform operations, network engineering, and service desk and field support, in a distributed, multi-site organization.
* Demonstrated success delivering infrastructure, network, or cloud modernization programs.
* Deep knowledge of Windows Server administration, Active Directory, Entra ID (Azure AD), ADFS, DNS/DHCP, and Windows and Azure security best practices.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, and Teams.
* Experience with virtualization platforms, enterprise storage, backup and recovery tools such as Rubrik, and/or Azure Site Recovery.
* Experience with Azure and AWS infrastructure and networking in a hybrid environment.
* Strong working knowledge of enterprise networking and network security, including Cisco and Meraki switching and wireless, Palo Alto firewalls, VPN, and WAN connectivity.
* Experience leading a Service Desk and IT service management team with defined service levels using an ITSM platform.
* Budget ownership and vendor management experience, including contract negotiation and telecom carrier management.
* Working knowledge of PCI, SOX, and related control and audit requirements.
* Experience with monitoring platforms such as Data Dog, PRTG, or similar enterprise monitoring and observability tools.
* PowerShell scripting, infrastructure-as-code, and automation experience.
* Experience with cloud-native network transit architectures, such as AWS Transit Gateway and Azure Virtual WAN, and migration away from virtual router appliances.
* ITIL 4 certification or equivalent IT service management training.
* Experience supporting retail, warehouse, or logistics operations, and managing geographically distributed, field, or contracted support teams.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator or Solutions Architect, AWS, CCNP, PMP, or CISSP.

**Skills And Ability**

* Strong leader who builds accountable, high-performing teams
* Hands-on technical depth to step in on complex escalations
* Ability to balance day-to-day operational demands with long-term strategic initiatives and to manage multiple priorities under pressure
* Clear, confident written and verbal communication with technical teams, executives, and business stakeholders
* Sound judgment and composure when leading critical incidents
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, planning, and prioritization skills
* Customer-service mindset focused on the employee experience

**Work Conditions/ Physical Demands**

* This position is primarily in a home office or at the Richardson, TX office. The employee is expected to maintain a safe, secure, and distraction-free workspace with reliable internet access. Duties primarily involve prolonged periods of sitting, working on a computer, and communicating via phone and video conferencing.
* The employee must be able to frequently use a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other standard office equipment, as well as communicate effectively with colleagues, customers, and business partners. Occasional lifting of office materials or equipment up to 15 pounds may be required.
* Availability for after-hours escalation of critical incidents and planned maintenance.
* Periodic visits to warehouses and retail facilities, which may involve noise, temperature variation, and active equipment.

**Travel**

* Occasional travel may be required for meetings, training, or business needs (up to 10%).

**Pay & Benefits**
Compensation is determined by various factors such as location, education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as internal and external equity and organizational needs. Additionally, this role is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.
  
  
The salary range for this position is $158,700 to $178,550 annually. The posted range reflects our national average range for the job. We may ultimately pay more or less than the published range based on the factors mentioned above. This range may be modified in the future.
  
  
**Benefits**
At Liquidity Services, we provide a comprehensive benefits package that supports our employees' well-being and provides growth opportunities and career development. Our offerings include:
  
  

* Competitive wages
* Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs, FSAs)
* 401(k) plan
* Paid time off (PTO) and holidays
* Paid parental leave
* Life and disability insurance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Professional development and tuition assistance

*Disclaimer: The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified. Liquidity Services Inc. reserves the right to modify position duties at any time due to business necessity.*
**Liquidity Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
**About Us**
Liquidity Services (NASDAQ: LQDT) operates the world’s largest B2B e-commerce marketplace platform for surplus assets, with over $15 billion in completed transactions to more than 6 million qualified buyers worldwide and 15,000 corporate and government sellers. It supports its clients’ sustainability efforts by helping them extend the life of assets, prevent unnecessary waste and carbon emissions, and reduce the number of products headed to landfills.

**Job Description**
**Baker Tilly is seeking a Managing Director, Managed Services Delivery & Experience to help lead and strengthen the client and delivery experience across our Managed Services platform.**
This role is accountable for creating a more consistent, scalable and differentiated experience across the full client lifecycle, from opportunity and onboarding through steady-state delivery, value realization and expansion.
  
  
The Managing Director will partner closely with Managed Services leadership, delivery teams, growth leaders, transitions, operations, technology, AI enablement and offshore teams to ensure clients experience Managed Services as one connected, accountable operating model.
  
  
This is a senior leadership role focused on building trust, consistency and operating discipline at scale. The right leader will understand recurring services, client relationship management, delivery governance and the behaviors required to create a high quality client experience across a complex, growing platform.
  
  
This leader will not only improve client satisfaction. They will help define what excellent Managed Services delivery looks like, where friction exists, how we improve consistency and how we create a stronger value proposition for clients over time.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and execution of the Managed Services client experience strategy across onboarding, transition, delivery, governance, service reviews and expansion.
* Define and implement standards for client communication, meeting cadence, executive reporting, escalation management, issue resolution and value realization.
* Partner with delivery leadership to ensure engagements have clear roles and responsibilities, KPIs, SLAs, governance routines and accountability structures.
* Serve as a senior advisor to delivery teams on complex client situations, executive conversations, service quality concerns and relationship risks.
* Identify common friction points across clients and teams, then translate those insights into scalable operating improvements, playbooks, tools and delivery standards.
* Partner with growth and account leadership to support retention, expansion and differentiated market positioning for Managed Services.
* Work with transitions teams to improve onboarding consistency, accelerate time to value and ensure new engagements are set up for long-term success.
* Collaborate with technology, AI and operations teams to improve workflow visibility, reporting, automation, data quality and client-facing insights.
* Create stronger feedback loops from clients, teams and leadership to improve service quality, client trust and platform performance.
* Help advance a culture of ownership, responsiveness, proactive communication and disciplined execution across Managed Services.
* Support strategic initiatives that improve scalability, margin, client retention, team effectiveness and market differentiation.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* The successful candidate will be an experienced executive leader with a strong background in managed services, professional services, client delivery, client success, operations, or transformation. This person should understand how to lead through complexity, influence across functions and build consistency without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.
* This leader must bring executive presence, strong client judgment, operational discipline, and the ability to connect strategy with day-to-day delivery behaviors. They should be equally comfortable working with senior clients, coaching internal teams, resolving delivery challenges and shaping broader platform improvements.

**Leadership Expectations**

* Creates clarity and consistency across a growing Managed Services platform.
* Builds trust with clients through discipline, communication and follow-through.
* Raises the standard for delivery behavior, governance and client experience.
* Connects client feedback to practical operating improvements.
* Partners across functions to make Managed Services feel like one firm, one team and one accountable model.
* Balances client experience, quality, margin, scalability and team capacity.
* Uses data, technology and AI-enabled tools to improve visibility, consistency and value.
* Helps teams move from reactive issue management to proactive service leadership.

**Why This Role Matters**

* Managed Services is built on long-term client relationships. The strength of those relationships depends not only on the services we provide, but on how clients experience our delivery every day.
* This role is central to making that experience more consistent, trusted and differentiated. The Managing Director will help shape the operating standards, client routines, feedback loops and leadership behaviors that allow Managed Services to scale with quality and discipline.
* As clients face more complexity, cost pressure, technology change and talent constraints, they need more than execution support. They need an accountable operating partner. This role helps ensure Baker Tilly delivers that promise with clarity, consistency and confidence.

**Required Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business required; CPA and/or MBA preferred.
* 15 or more years of experience in managed services, professional services, outsourcing, client success, operations, transformation or technology-enabled delivery.
* Experience leading client experience, delivery governance, service quality or recurring services across a multi-client portfolio.
* Demonstrated ability to work with senior client executives and internal leadership on complex delivery, relationship and value realization matters.
* Strong understanding of onboarding, transitions, service delivery, KPIs, SLAs, escalation management, executive reporting and client retention.
* Experience building scalable operating standards, playbooks, governance models or client journey frameworks.
* Proven ability to influence across delivery, growth, operations, technology, offshore and executive stakeholder groups.
* Experience supporting growth, expansion and account development in a recurring services environment.
* Strong commercial judgment, including understanding of engagement economics, scope management, delivery quality and margin protection.
* Experience with workflow tools, automation, AI-enabled delivery, operational reporting or digital service models preferred.
* The compensation range for this role is $182,150 to $345,350. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.

Experience leading infrastructure operations across networking, cloud, server, monitoring, disaster recovery, and infrastructure engineering functions strongly preferred.

Title: Director of IT - Infrastructure and Operations

This is a broad operating leadership role. You will lead global infrastructure and Service Desk operations, develop a lean team, and get consistent results from our service providers. The operation is functioning, but too much time goes into reacting to issues. The opportunity is to strengthen ownership, follow through on commitments, and address the causes of recurring problems. We want an operation that responds well today and becomes more capable and self-managing over time.

Title: Cloud Infrastructure Manager
Description:
Cloud Infrastructure Manager
  
**The role**

Lead the cloud infrastructure that runs myZoi’s production platforms across AWS and Azure, keeping them reliable, secure, scalable and cost-effective.

This is a player-coach role. You will manage the DevOps and SRE team while staying hands-on in design, implementation and incident response, with particular depth in cloud and infrastructure networking.

You will own the infrastructure roadmap, operational performance and delivery of improvements. You will work closely with Architecture, Engineering, Cybersecurity and Technology Operations to support business growth and maintain service continuity.

Key responsibilities
  
  
Team leadership
  
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop the DevOps and SRE team; set clear objectives and manage performance.
* Plan priorities across operational work, improvements and projects, with clear owners, milestones and escalation of risks.
* Build on-call arrangements, backup coverage and knowledge sharing so no service depends on a single engineer; take part in the escalation rota.
* Report proactively on service health, delivery progress, costs and material risks.

Hands-on infrastructure and networking
  
  
  

* Design, build and operate cloud networking across AWS and Azure, including VPC/VNet design, hub-and-spoke or transit topologies, routing, DNS, load balancing, private endpoints and hybrid connectivity (VPN, AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute).
* Implement network security controls, including segmentation, firewalls, security groups and NSGs, WAF and secure ingress and egress.
* Build and operate compute, storage, managed databases and Kubernetes platforms, with clear segregation of production and non-production environments.
* Write and review Terraform, and set standards for configuration management, patching and lifecycle management using version control, peer review and automated checks.
* Develop infrastructure designs with Architecture and implement the agreed standards.
* Lead the technical planning and execution of migrations and infrastructure transitions, including testing, cutover, rollback and handover.

DevOps and reliability
  
  
  

* Oversee infrastructure automation, deployment tooling and CI/CD in partnership with Engineering.
* Improve monitoring, observability and actionable alerting; agree service-level objectives with service owners.
* Own infrastructure-level escalation and restoration during incidents, then drive root-cause analysis and lasting fixes.
* Maintain capacity and performance plans aligned with expected demand.

Backup and disaster recovery
  
  
  

* Own infrastructure backup, restore and recovery mechanisms.
* Plan and run recovery tests with Technology Operations and application owners, validating agreed RTO and RPO targets.

Security and compliance
  
  
  

* Implement cloud security controls in line with Cybersecurity policies, including identity and privileged access, encryption, logging and secrets management.
* Ensure vulnerabilities and configuration weaknesses are remediated within agreed timelines.
* Apply regulatory, data-residency and contractual requirements to infrastructure, with guidance from the responsible functions.
* Maintain current infrastructure documentation, recovery procedures and auditable records of access, changes, control operation and test results; support internal and external reviews.

Cost and supplier management
  
  
  

* Manage cloud spend within approved budgets, with transparent allocation, forecasting and reporting.
* Drive cost optimisation through rightsizing, commitment-based purchasing and removal of unused resources.
* Manage the technical performance of cloud and infrastructure suppliers, supporting commercial decisions with Finance and Procurement.

Experience and capabilities
  

* Typically 8 or more years in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps or related disciplines, including at least 3 years managing engineers.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams that run business-critical production services, while remaining hands-on.
* Strong hands-on experience with both AWS and Azure. Experience with cross-cloud migration is advantageous.
* Deep networking expertise across cloud and hybrid environments: TCP/IP, routing, subnetting, DNS, load balancing, VPN and private connectivity, firewalls and segmentation, and troubleshooting complex connectivity issues.
* Practical expertise in identity and access management, Terraform, Kubernetes, CI/CD and observability.
* Experience with disaster recovery testing, major incidents, infrastructure security and cost optimisation.
* Ability to challenge technical proposals, prioritise competing demands and explain decisions in clear business terms.
* Proven delivery through internal teams and external suppliers, with effective delegation and proactive escalation.
* Financial-services, payments or other regulated-sector experience is preferred.

Qualifications
  

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Relevant AWS, Azure, Terraform or Kubernetes certifications are desirable.
* Networking certifications (for example AWS Advanced Networking, Azure Network Engineer Associate or CCNP) are a plus.
* Familiarity with ITIL and recognised security frameworks is advantageous.

Title: Network Security Lead- Cloud Infrastructure
Description:
**Job Description**
Own the end-to-end architecture, design, deployment, and 24/7 operational management of secure network and security infrastructure across cloud (Azure, GCP, OCI) and on-premises environments — spanning routing, switching, and cybersecurity engineering. Act as the technical authority responsible for designing highly available, resilient architectures; leading deployment and configuration of new environments; and operating the infrastructure around the clock to ensure it remains stable, secure, and audit-ready. Skilled in preparing operational reports and presentations, running operational meetings, handling escalations, and managing major changes — while retaining hands-on accountability for daily operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design secure reference architectures for hub-spoke topologies, VNet/VPC/VCN environments, subnetting, IP/CIDR planning, and static/BGP dynamic routing across Azure, GCP, and OCI, as well as on-prem routing and switching infrastructure.
* Architect secure connectivity patterns — VPN, peering, and dedicated interconnects (ExpressRoute, Interconnect, FastConnect) — and lead network security design reviews with actionable, best-practice recommendations.
* Lead deployment and configuration of network security environments: Site-to-Site VPNs with redundant tunnels and BGP routing, VPC/VCN peering, NSGs, security lists/ACLs, NVAs, next-gen firewalls, and Internet/NAT/Service Gateways for new builds and migrations.
* Design, deploy, and operate infrastructure to meet 24/7 availability targets, including redundancy, failover, load balancing, and disaster recovery across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Own round-the-clock operational management of the network and security environment: change management, patching/upgrades of NVAs, vulnerability tracking and remediation, and coordination of patch windows and incident response.
* Manage and oversee day-to-day network and security operations across routing, switching, and cybersecurity engineering, keeping leadership informed of status, risks, and escalations.
* Configure and maintain monitoring, logging, and diagnostics (Azure Monitor, GCP Cloud Monitoring, OCI Monitoring, flow logs) to proactively detect and resolve availability, performance, and security issues.
* Harden network device and cloud configurations against industry benchmarks (e.g., CIS, NIST) and internal security baselines; remediate findings from internal/external audits.
* Prepare and present operational reports, dashboards, and presentations summarizing network/security performance, availability, incidents, and risk posture to leadership and stakeholders.
* Plan and run operational meetings — daily/weekly stand-ups, service reviews, and incident review sessions — driving action items to closure.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical operational and security issues across all managed platforms, ensuring timely resolution and clear communication.
* Own and handle major changes end-to-end — planning, risk assessment, change advisory board (CAB) submissions, implementation, and post-change validation — with minimal impact to 24/7 availability.
* Design, deploy, and validate backup and restore procedures for NVAs, firewall policies, and network configuration state; own disaster recovery and cross-region DR networking design.
* Coordinate cross-functional activities with cloud, security, application, and operations teams to ensure consistent security posture and always-on availability across the environment.
* Maintain accurate architecture documentation, network diagrams, runbooks, and operational procedures; ensure changes follow proper governance, risk, and change-control processes.
* Mentor engineers and act as a point of technical escalation for complex operational or security issues.
* Participate in an on-call rotation and respond to critical incidents outside business hours to maintain 24/7 availability; travel to datacenter or client sites as needed.

**Qualifications**

* 10–12 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, network operations, and cybersecurity engineering, including hands-on ownership of designing, deploying, and operating secure network infrastructure.
* Demonstrable depth across at least two of Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (all three strongly preferred).
* Proven experience designing and operating infrastructure to meet 24/7 availability, redundancy, and disaster recovery requirements.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing or coordinating multi-disciplinary operations (network + security) and reporting outcomes to leadership.
* Strong skills in preparing operational reports, dashboards, and presentations for leadership and stakeholder audiences.
* Proven track record running operational meetings and driving structured escalation handling to resolution.
* Hands-on experience managing major changes, including change planning, risk assessment, CAB processes, and post-implementation review.
* Hands-on expertise with enterprise routers, switches, firewalls, NVAs, and cloud-native network security monitoring tools.
* Experience hardening network and cloud infrastructure against security frameworks and remediating audit findings.
* Strong troubleshooting and incident-response experience across routing, switching, cloud networking, and security domains.
* Excellent coordination and communication skills, with the ability to work closely with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Willing and able to participate in an on-call rotation and travel to datacenter/client sites as needed to maintain 24/7 availability.

**Required Certifications**

* Cisco CCNP (Enterprise / Security) or equivalent vendor-neutral routing & switching certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Security Engineer Associate (or Azure Solutions Architect Expert).
* Google Professional Cloud Network Engineer / Cloud Security Engineer.
* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Network Security Professional or Architect Professional.
* CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) or working toward certification.
* Firewall/NGFW vendor certification (e.g., Palo Alto PCNSA/PCNSE, Fortinet NSE, or Check Point CCSA/CCSE).

*Preferred: CCIE, CISM, CEH. At least two of Azure, GCP, and OCI required; all three strongly preferred. Certifications must be current; equivalent recognized credentials considered subject to approval.*

Title: Senior Customer Delivery Manager
Description:
**About the role**

As a Senior Customer Delivery Manager, you will be accountable for leading the delivery of contracted Run Services for a large customer account or a portfolio of smaller accounts.

You will lead and manage teams of people, both directly and through matrix management. You’ll implement and operate an effective governance model to ensure that the services are delivered to satisfy both the Customer’s and Computacenter’s required outcomes, including but not limited to service levels, customer satisfaction and financial targets. You’ll also play a key role in the account leadership team working together to grow Computacenter’s business with the Customer.

You’ll have a role to play as a coach and mentor to other employees to ensure the continuous development of Computacenter and its people, not just as a Line Manager within your own team. You’ll also have a responsibility to engage and play a part as a senior manager in the wider organisation, working within strategic change and ongoing transformational initiatives in our Group Delivery business.

**What you’ll be doing**

* You'll be a part of the Delivery Leadership team, either in your own right or reporting through the Delivery Lead/Senior Delivery Lead to our customers.
* You'll have clear areas of accountability and will be given appropriate autonomy to lead the areas of the service that you are responsible for.
* You'll also form part of a wider community of Delivery Lead’s and will have the opportunity to actively contribute to wider in-country Delivery initiatives.

Delivery Leadership

* Lead and manage the delivery of run and change services to deliver what we’ve promised our customer and our own organization.
* Constantly drive us to do better for our customer and our own organization.
* Objectively manage performance of our internal and partner delivery teams.
* Be able to demonstrate understanding of our performance, what it means to our customer’s business, and what we’re doing to improve.
* Look to continually improve both the efficiency & effectiveness of delivery processes and services, adding value that is relevant to the customer throughout the contract lifecycle.
* Identify risks in service delivery, assess commercial implications and take measures to eliminate risk or avoid risk.

Change Delivery Management

* It’s likely that you’ll have a role leading change for our customers. Sometimes this will be relatively simple in-life service change, sometimes in supporting out Group Services colleagues it will be pulling the Computacenter organization together to deliver more complex change. In carrying out these duties, you will demonstrate awareness of relevant project management approaches.
* You’ll use your contacts and insight to identify new ways in which Computacenter can add value to our customers.

Business Leadership

* Work with the Senior Delivery Manager/Delivery Director as well as Group Services and other colleagues, as appropriate, to support the account strategy and to ensure that Computacenter presents itself as a single, joined-up team to the customer.
* Contribute to and deliver against a communications plan, both customer-facing & internal, ensuring clear & consistent messaging both verbally & in written form across various media.

Contract Management

* Support Group Services in the development, negotiation, and agreement of contract changes within the Customer account.
* Support the management of the contract schedules that relate to your scope of service. You’ll ensure compliance and manage exceptions.

Financial Management

* Manage the finances of your account or assigned services to ensure accurate forecasting and cost management to achieve or exceed financial baselines.

Relationship Management

* Work with the Delivery Lead/Snr Lead and account team to define and support the engagement strategy with the customer and other stakeholders.
* Primary interface to one or more senior stakeholders within the customer organization ensuring that you maintain a positive and constructive relationship to the benefit of both organizations.

* You’ll be an experienced practitioner in IT Service Management.
* You’re likely trained in ITIL, possibly to Expert status.

There’s so much more to enjoy about being at Computacenter than just having a rewarding career. Computacenter is a leading independent technology partner, trusted by large corporate and public sector organizations. In the US, we support some of the country’s best-known businesses with regional hubs in San Francisco and Irvine, CA; Norcross, GA; Plano, TX; and New York City; and Integration Centers in Silicon Valley and Atlanta. www.computacenter.com/us

Title: Problem & Incident Manager
Description:
**Introduction**
Since 1973, East West Bank has served as a pathway to success. With over 110 locations across the U.S. and Asia, we are the premier financial bridge between the East and West. Our teams of experienced, multi-cultural professionals help guide businesses and community members on both sides of the Pacific looking to explore new markets and create new opportunities, and our sustained growth and expertise in industries like real estate, entertainment and media, private equity and venture capital, and high-tech help build sustainable businesses and expand our associates’ potential for career advancement.
  
  
Headquartered in California, East West Bank (Nasdaq: EWBC) is a top-performing commercial bank with a strong foundation, an enterprising spirit and a commitment to absolute integrity. East West Bank gives people the confidence to reach further.
  
  
**Overview**
East West Bank is seeking an experienced Problem & Incident Manager to join the Network Operations Center (NOC) organization and lead Problem Management practices across the enterprise. This position will also support the Major Incident Management function within NOC. The Problem & Incident Manager will play a key role in supporting the Bank's missioncritical technology environment, banking applications that require high availability and operational resilience. This position partners closely with NOC leadership, service owners, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to maintain service stability, improve operational maturity, and drive continuous service improvement.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Problem Management**

* Own the enterprise Problem Management process from identification through closure.
* Analyze incident trends to identify recurring service disruptions and systemic technology risks.
* Facilitate Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations following major incidents and recurring issues.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams in identifying root causes, contributing factors, and corrective actions.
* Ensure corrective actions are assigned, tracked, and completed according to established timelines.
* Conduct problem review meetings and report status to technology leadership.
* Maintain a repository of Known Errors, Workarounds, and Problem Records.
* Drive permanent resolution efforts that reduce incident volume and improve service reliability.

**Major Incident Management**

* Lead real-time Major Incident Management activities for technology incidents impacting business-critical systems and services.
* Assume the role of Incident Commander during Severity 1 and Severity 2 incidents.
* Coordinate technical response teams across Infrastructure, Cloud, Network, Security, Desktop Services, Telecom, and Application Support groups.
* Facilitate incident bridge calls and ensure effective communication between technical teams and business stakeholders.
* Drive rapid service restoration while minimizing business impact.
* Maintain executive visibility through timely status updates, impact assessments, and business communications.
* Monitor incidents through resolution and ensure all actions are documented within the ITSM platform.
* Establish and continually improve Major Incident Management procedures, playbooks, and escalation processes.

**Operational Excellence & Reporting**

* Develop and maintain key operational dashboards and metrics for Incident and Problem Management.
* Analyze operational trends and provide recommendations for continual improvement.
* Assist leadership with creation and analysis of operational reports, service metrics, and executive dashboards.
* Support regulatory, audit, risk management, and compliance reporting requirements.

**NOC & Technology Operations Support**

* Partner closely with NOC teams to provide 24x7 operational support for business critical banking applications and infrastructure platforms.
* Support monitoring, escalation, and coordination activities for critical production environments.
* Participate in operational readiness reviews, maintenance planning, disaster recovery exercises, and change risk assessments.
* Assist with service restoration activities involving cloud services, enterprise infrastructure, networking, telecommunications, and business applications.
* Support incident response activities impacting Azure, Microsoft 365, networking, telecommunications, voice systems, and enterprise platforms.

**Compliance, Governance & Risk Management**

* Ensure all Incident and Problem Management activities comply with bankingregulatory expectations including FDIC, SEC, FFIEC, SOX, and internal audit requirements.
* Maintain complete documentation and evidentiary records supporting audits and examinations.
* Participate in regulatory reviews, audits, and operational risk assessments as required.
* Promote adherence to ITSM governance frameworks, operational controls, and service management best practices.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 7 years of experience in Problem and Incident Management, Major Incident Management, NOC Operations or Technology Operations.
* Experience leading enterprise-wide incident response involving multiple technology teams.
* Experience conducting Root Cause Analysis and managing corrective action programs.
* Strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM) concepts including Incident, Problem, Change, and Major Incident Management.
* Experience with Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or similar ITSM platforms.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Exceptional documentation, organizational, and analytical abilities.
* Ability to perform effectively during high-pressure and high-visibility incidents.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL Foundation or ITIL Managing Professional Certification.
* Experience supporting financial services, banking, or highly regulated environments.
* Experience with LogicMonitor, Splunk, Grafana, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Datadog, or similar observability platforms.
* Familiarity with FFIEC, FDIC, SOX, and regulatory technology controls.
* Knowledge of cloud, network, server, storage, and end-user computing environments.

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the United States. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.
  
  
**Success Measures**

* Reduction in repeat incidents and chronic service disruptions.
* Timely completion of Root Cause Analyses and corrective actions.
* Effective management of Severity 1 and Severity 2 incidents.
* Increased service reliability and availability across critical banking platforms.
* Strong audit and regulatory compliance outcomes.
* Improved executive visibility into operational risks and service health.
* Mature and measurable Incident and Problem Management practices aligned with ITIL best practices.

The base pay range for this position is USD $115,000.00/Yr. - USD $165,000.00/Yr. Exact offers will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

Title: Incident Response Manager - Product & Engineering
Description:
**About Anthropic**
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an Incident Response Manager to serve as the operational backbone of how Anthropic handles incidents. When things go wrong, you are the person who makes sure the right people are in the room, the right information is flowing, and nothing falls through the cracks.
  
  
The right person for this role brings structure and rigor to high-volume, high-stakes situations without waiting for a playbook to be handed to them. You will work across engineering, product, security, legal, go-to-market, and leadership to ensure Anthropic responds to incidents with speed, clarity, and accountability. This is not a role where you follow existing runbooks; it is a role where you write them, and where you operate effectively even when the runbook does not yet exist.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build the incident response management function, establishing the processes, tooling, and operational standards that define how we handle incidents at scale
* Serve as an on-call incident commander, driving coordinated response across technical and non-technical stakeholders during incidents of varying severity, including managing multiple active incidents simultaneously
* Engage the right people at the right time, with a strong sense of urgency, bringing order and direction to fast-moving, ambiguous situations
* Own incident communications end-to-end, from real-time internal coordination to external channels like status pages, direct customer outreach, and stakeholder updates, ensuring they reflect Anthropic's commitments to safety, transparency, and accuracy
* Participate in blameless incident reviews, contributing operational context and helping drive follow-through on critical remediations so the same class of incident does not recur
* Partner with engineering teams to develop and maintain incident response policies, procedures, and escalation frameworks that scale with Anthropic's growth
* Partner with engineering, product, security, legal, and go-to-market teams to continuously improve how the organization detects, responds to, and learns from incidents

**You May Be a Good Fit If You**

* Have 5+ years of experience in incident management, with direct experience managing technical product or infrastructure incidents (not exclusively security or trust and safety)
* Have built or significantly shaped an incident response program, ideally at a high-growth startup or in an environment where you had to create structure rather than inherit it
* Demonstrate a strong sense of ownership and urgency, with the ability to operate independently and make sound decisions under pressure without waiting for direction
* Are comfortable working in unprecedented situations where processes are still being defined and guidance may be incomplete or conflicting, leaving things better than you found them
* Have a track record of effective cross-functional collaboration, particularly with engineering, security, legal, communications, go-to-market, and executive leadership
* Bring a blameless, learning-oriented mindset to incident reviews, focused on systemic improvement rather than individual fault
* Have experience with cloud infrastructure incidents and enough technical depth across the stack to engage meaningfully with engineering teams during response, including comfort navigating distributed systems, monitoring tools, and logs
* Are analytically minded, with experience using data (incident metrics, queries, trend analysis) to inform decisions during response and to drive operational improvements over time
* Communicate clearly and calmly under pressure, both in real-time coordination and in post-incident written communications
* Thrive in high-volume, fast-paced environments and are energized by bringing operational discipline to complex, evolving situations

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
  
  
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Title: SERVICE DELIVERY MANAGER
Description:
