With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.  
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.

  

**About Atos Group**

Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.

  

**Network Platform Lead**

**Role Summary**

The Network Platform Lead is the single accountable leader for the Texas Private Cloud Network Platform and its outcomes across strategy, engineering, operations, service delivery, modernization, capacity, security, financial performance, and workforce capability.  
The role owns the network as an integrated platform rather than a collection of individual technologies or operational teams. Its mission is to provide reliable, secure, scalable, automated, and measurable connectivity services that enable every other TPC platform and the State of Texas agencies that depend upon them.

The Network Platform encompasses network operations and architecture execution, routing and switching, firewalls, load balancing, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, VPN, network automation, data-center connectivity, and specialized network fabrics. These are managed as platform capabilities and customer-consumable services rather than isolated technology silos.

The Network Platform Lead sets the direction for evolving this environment from primarily device- and ticket-oriented network operations toward a standardized, software-defined, automated, observable, and service-oriented network platform.  
Success is measured not simply by whether network devices are operational, but by whether applications, infrastructure platforms and agencies receive the connectivity, availability, performance, security, capacity and speed of delivery they require.  
  
Key Accountabilities  
Platform Strategy & Roadmap  
Own the Network Platform strategy and multi-year roadmap, aligned with TPC modernization priorities, CTO architecture direction, customer requirements and the roadmaps of Compute, Data, AI, Mainframe and Data Center platforms.  
Translate architectural direction into an executable network platform roadmap spanning Run, Change and Evolve.  
Define the evolution of routing, switching, firewalls, load balancing, DNS/DHCP/IPAM, VPN, data-center fabrics and emerging software-defined networking capabilities.

Establish clear connectivity standards and drive adoption of reusable network services rather than bespoke configurations.  
Maintain a prioritized platform backlog balancing availability, technical debt, lifecycle, security, automation, capacity, customer demand and modernization.

Network Operations & Reliability  
Be accountable for the end-to-end health, availability and performance of the Network Platform, including 24x7 operations.  
Own operational outcomes across incidents, problems, changes, configuration, firmware, maintenance and network service restoration.  
Meet or exceed contractual network availability and service-level commitments.  
Establish meaningful SLIs, SLOs and KPIs for availability, latency, packet loss, capacity, change quality, incidents and service-request performance.  
Drive permanent elimination of recurring network incidents and chronic conditions rather than allowing repetitive operational work to become normalized.  
Improve resilience and fault tolerance across network paths, devices and critical connectivity services.  
Lead TPC's network response during major incidents affecting network services and participate in TxDIR-convened MIRTs when Network owns the affected service. This follows TPC's model where incident execution accountability remains with the platform that owns the affected service.

Network Engineering & Automation  
Transform network delivery from predominantly manual device configuration toward policy-driven, repeatable and automated network services.  
Establish standard configuration and deployment patterns for network capabilities.  
Expand Infrastructure-as-Code and Network-as-Code practices for configuration, validation and lifecycle activities.  
Automate high-volume and repeatable network workflows, particularly provisioning, configuration validation, compliance, changes and service requests.  
Introduce automated pre-change and post-change validation to reduce change-related incidents.  
Partner with Platform Engineering & Automation to build reusable pipelines, workflows, integrations and self-service capabilities rather than creating isolated automation inside Network. TPC's target operating model explicitly places shared automation with Platform Engineering while platforms remain accountable for operating their services.  
Reduce network fulfillment time and manual effort while improving configuration consistency and auditability.

Modernization & Lifecycle  
Own the Network Platform modernization roadmap across hardware, software, firmware, network services and management tooling.  
Maintain an actionable lifecycle plan covering routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers and other network-owned appliances.  
Identify technical debt, obsolescence, capacity constraints, unsupported versions and architectural limitations before they create service or security risks.  
Drive upgrades and technology refreshes toward strategic standards instead of maintaining unnecessary technology variants.  
Treat network modernization as an ongoing platform responsibility rather than an episodic refresh program.  
Own firmware lifecycle for network devices including firewalls, routers, switches, load balancers and fabric switches, consistent with TPC's defined technical-ownership model.  
Connectivity Services & Customer Experience  
Treat firewall, load-balancing, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, VPN and other connectivity capabilities as services, each with clear ownership, standards and measurable outcomes.  
Make network services easier to understand, request, provision, change and support.  
Reduce fulfillment times for common network requests through standard patterns and automation.  
Establish service owners for significant cataloged Network services as the catalog evolves. Under the TPC ownership model, service ownership is an assigned responsibility beneath the Platform Lead rather than necessarily a management position.  
Reduce unnecessary customer-specific network implementations where a secure, supportable shared pattern can meet the requirement.

Capacity & Performance  
Own Network capacity, including bandwidth and port capacity, while Operations Intelligence provides enterprise-level forecasting, trending and cross-platform visibility.  
Maintain forward-looking network capacity plans based on utilization, growth, customer demand and platform roadmaps.  
Establish thresholds and triggers so capacity constraints are addressed before they affect service.  
Provide Network capacity requirements into broader TPC planning for Compute, Data, AI and Data Center infrastructure.  
Ensure monitoring provides actionable visibility into congestion, saturation, latency, packet loss and other indicators of network health.

Security & Compliance  
Own the Network Platform's implementation of required security controls, configuration standards and vulnerability remediation in partnership with the CISO organization.  
Maintain secure configurations and lifecycle discipline across network-managed infrastructure.  
Drive vulnerability remediation and eliminate unsupported or security-risk technologies.  
Incorporate security controls into standard network patterns and automation wherever practical.  
Partner with Security on firewall and network-control requirements while maintaining clear separation between security governance/risk ownership and operational execution. TPC's target model assigns policy, risk and GRC to the CISO while platforms execute remediation and operate their infrastructure.

Cross-Platform Enablement  
Network is foundational to virtually every TPC service. The Network Platform Lead therefore owns the Network side of critical cross-platform capabilities, including:  
Compute and VMware connectivity.  
OpenShift and container networking.  
Storage and Data Platform connectivity.  
Backup, replication and DR network paths.  
Mainframe connectivity.  
Data Center physical network infrastructure dependencies.  
AI/GPU networking and fabric.  
Tenant segmentation and network isolation.  
For AI specifically, Network owns the GPU fabric, tenant network isolation and fabric-switch firmware, while other portions of the GPU stack remain with AI, Compute and Data Center.  
This requires the Network Platform Lead to operate as a peer platform owner, not as a downstream fulfillment team receiving tickets from the other platforms.  
Service & Customer Leadership  
Represent the Network Platform to DIR, the MSI, Texas agencies, other STS providers and strategic technology partners.  
Translate customer requirements into scalable platform capabilities and roadmap priorities.  
Own network-related customer escalations and ensure systemic issues result in corrective action.  
Provide clear visibility into platform health, lifecycle, capacity, security posture and roadmap.  
Maintain customer relationships for the Network Platform as part of the defined Platform Lead model. Platform Leads remain customer-facing under the current TPC target organization.

People & Capability Leadership  
Lead and develop the Network organization across Network Operations, engineering and architecture execution, while preserving specialized technical capabilities where appropriate.  
Evolve skills from traditional network administration toward network automation, Infrastructure-as-Code, software-defined networking, observability, API integration and SRE practices.  
Build sufficient technical depth and succession coverage for critical networking technologies.  
Develop modern networking skills required by emerging platforms, particularly OpenShift/container networking and GPU/AI network fabrics.  
Establish clear accountability across operations, engineering, architecture implementation and service ownership.  
Build an engineering culture focused on standardization, automation, measurable reliability and continuous improvement.

What the Network Platform Lead Owns

The Network Platform Lead is ultimately accountable for:  
Platform health | Connectivity | Network availability & performance | Customer experience | Platform roadmap | Capacity | Lifecycle | Network automation | Technical debt | Security posture | Service standardization | Network service delivery | Workforce capability | Continuous improvement  
The role does not simply manage network devices, engineers or ticket queues.  
It owns the Network Platform as a foundational TPC capability and is accountable for how well that platform performs today, how efficiently customers consume its services, and how it evolves to support TPC's future Compute, Data and AI services.

Experience & Capabilities  
Significant leadership experience operating large-scale enterprise or service-provider network environments in an SLA-driven environment, preferably public sector or another highly regulated environment.  
Strong understanding of enterprise routing, switching, firewalls, load balancing, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, VPN and data-center networking.  
Experience with highly available data-center network architectures and network segmentation.  
Practical understanding of network automation, APIs, Infrastructure-as-Code, configuration management, Git-based workflows and automated validation.  
Understanding of modern container and Kubernetes/OpenShift networking.  
Ability to develop capability around emerging high-performance Ethernet/GPU fabrics required by AI services. TPC's target model explicitly places GPU fabric and network isolation with Network.  
Strong ITIL/service-management knowledge and experience operating with ServiceNow in a multi-supplier model, particularly important because the MSI owns and operates ServiceNow as the common STS system of record.  
Strong capacity, lifecycle and vendor-management discipline.  
Working knowledge of security, vulnerability management and regulatory/compliance requirements.  
Ability to translate technical strategy into an executable platform roadmap with measurable outcomes.  
Strong leadership and workforce-development capabilities, including transitioning traditional network operations toward platform engineering and automation.  
Executive-level communication skills and the ability to represent the platform credibly with DIR, agencies, vendors and internal leadership.

Definition of Success  
A successful Network Platform Lead progressively creates an environment where:  
Network availability and performance are predictable and measurable.  
Recurring network incidents decline.  
Network changes become safer and increasingly automated.  
Firewall and connectivity fulfillment times materially improve.  
Standard network patterns replace unnecessary bespoke configurations.  
Capacity constraints are identified before customers experience them.  
Configuration drift and manual errors decline.  
Lifecycle and security risks are actively driven down.  
Network services become increasingly API-driven and self-service capable.  
Network supports Compute, Data, AI and the other platforms as a strategic enabler rather than a ticket-driven dependency.  
Engineers spend less time performing repetitive configuration and more time improving the platform.  
The Network Platform has a clear roadmap, measurable health and one accountable owner.

Title: System & Network Administration Lead
Description:
**Who we are**

At Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we believe education is more than the pursuit of knowledge – it is a catalyst for transformation. Our mission, grounded in democratizing education, is to create access for learners from every background and empower them to achieve their aspirations and advance their careers.

We are committed to delivering rigorous, flexible programs that are both personally fulfilling and professionally rewarding, while contributing to the betterment of society. Since 2004, Yorkville has been among Canada’s few private, for-profit, fully accredited degree-granting universities, with campuses in Ontario, British Columbia, and New Brunswick. Together with Toronto Film School, we offer creative and academic pathways at both the college and university levels, cultivating a multidisciplinary environment where innovation and the arts converge.

Our community is vibrant and diverse. Many of our learners are adults balancing education with careers and personal commitments. Every member of our team – whether in teaching, operations, or technology – is dedicated to removing barriers and expanding access. Together, we deliver flexible, industry-informed learning that leads to meaningful opportunities.

At our core is human connection – guiding people to reimagine their futures in a community defined by opportunity, creativity, and growth.

**Who we need**

Reporting to the Director IT Security and Infrastructure we are hiring an System & Network Administration Lead to join our IT Operations team. As our new System & Network Administration Lead, you will lead the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and evolution of our cloud and on-premises infrastructure across a multi-site environment. You will take hands-on ownership of Azure, Microsoft 365, Windows Server and virtual machines, network infrastructure, firewalls, and infrastructure automation, ensuring our systems are reliable, secure, scalable, and performing effectively. Working closely with IT Operations, Network, Security, and external partners, you will lead infrastructure upgrades and improvements, strengthen operational practices, and act as the senior escalation point for complex infrastructure issues.

*This is an existing full-time role, working 2 days remotely and 3 days on-site at 85 Richmond Street West, with a move to our new headquarters at 120 Bloor Street East in Fall 2026.*

**What's in it for you**

*Ownership and impact.*
You will take meaningful ownership of the infrastructure that supports a growing, multi-site organization, working across Azure, Microsoft 365, servers, virtualization, networking, and security. This is an opportunity to strengthen how core infrastructure is managed, introduce greater consistency and automation, and directly influence the reliability, performance, and security of the technology environment.

*Technical breadth and modernization.*
You will work across cloud and on-premises technologies, giving you the opportunity to solve complex infrastructure challenges rather than being limited to one area. You will deepen your expertise across Azure, Microsoft 365, PowerShell automation, Windows Server, virtualization, firewalls, and networking while contributing to upgrades, migrations, infrastructure improvements, and emerging technology initiatives.

*Growth and leadership.*
You will join an IT Operations team where you can expand both your technical influence and leadership capabilities. As the infrastructure environment and team practices continue to evolve, you will have opportunities to lead projects, mentor technical team members, strengthen operational practices, and take on broader ownership.

**As our new System & Network Administration Lead, you will:**

* **Manage cloud and Microsoft environments.**
  You will manage, maintain, and optimize Azure infrastructure and Microsoft 365 environments, including Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID, and OneDrive. You will apply industry best practices and security standards to strengthen performance, reliability, and scalability.
* **Automate and improve.**
  You will develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate Azure infrastructure management, deployments, configuration, and routine operational tasks. You will identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and strengthen infrastructure practices.
* **Maintain and modernize infrastructure.**
  You will plan and execute Windows Server and virtual machine upgrades, migrations, patching, and ongoing maintenance across cloud and on-premises environments. You will monitor performance, proactively identify issues, and help ensure systems remain available, secure, and effective as needs evolve.
* **Strengthen network operations.**
  You will configure, maintain, troubleshoot, and upgrade network infrastructure, including Azure and Enterprise Grade Network Equipment, VLANs, LAN/WAN environments, VPNs, and wireless systems. You will work closely with the IT Security team to apply hardening standards, address vulnerabilities, and ensure infrastructure deployments are appropriately secured.
* **Lead infrastructure projects and support.**
  You will lead and coordinate infrastructure upgrades, migrations, deployments, and other technical initiatives, working across IT teams, business units, and external vendors. You will also provide hands-on L2/L3 operational support and act as a senior escalation point for complex infrastructure issues.
* **Strengthen operational practices.**
  You will apply ITIL practices across incident, problem, and change management and contribute to the continuous improvement of infrastructure operations. You will provide technical scoping and cost estimates to support capital and operating budget planning and help bring greater structure and consistency to how infrastructure is managed.
* **Provide technical leadership.**
  You will share your expertise with technical team members, provide guidance on complex infrastructure challenges, and help strengthen capabilities across the team. You will build collaborative relationships across IT and the broader organization to ensure infrastructure services continue to meet operational needs.

**You have:**

* **The infrastructure experience.**
  You have hands-on experience managing and supporting complex cloud and on-premises infrastructure, ideally within a multi-site environment. You are comfortable taking ownership of critical systems, troubleshooting complex issues, and supporting infrastructure through upgrades, migrations, and ongoing operational improvements.
* **The Microsoft expertise.**
  You have strong practical experience with Azure and Microsoft 365 environments, including Windows Server, virtual machines, Entra ID, Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, and OneDrive. You can use PowerShell to automate infrastructure management, configuration, deployments, and recurring operational tasks.
* **The networking and security knowledge.**
  You have experience configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise network infrastructure, including firewalls, switches, VLANs, LAN/WAN environments, VPNs, and wireless systems. Experience Enterprise Grade Network Equipment is valuable. You understand cybersecurity best practices and can partner effectively with Security teams to strengthen infrastructure and address vulnerabilities.
* **The operational mindset.**
  You understand ITIL practices and how they apply to incident, problem, and change management. You bring a proactive approach to monitoring infrastructure, identifying risks, resolving issues, and improving the reliability, performance, and consistency of IT operations.
* **The leadership and communication skills.**
  You can lead technical initiatives, provide guidance and mentorship to colleagues, and act as a trusted escalation point when complex issues arise. You communicate technical information clearly and can build productive relationships with IT teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and external partners.
* **The certifications.**
  Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Fortinet Network Security Expert (NSE), and ITIL certifications are assets rather than requirements.

**Why work at Yorkville University?**

At Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we are united by a shared purpose: placing the student experience at the heart of everything we do. Whether you are teaching, designing curriculum, advising learners, advancing technology, or supporting operations, your work directly fuels learning potential, strengthens inclusive communities, and fosters purposeful curiosity.

Here, professional growth is part of our culture. In your role, you will have opportunities to help the launch of career-relevant programs, expand your expertise, and access tuition-free courses across our institutions - from certificates to master’s degrees. Curiosity, initiative, and innovation are encouraged, and your ideas can move from vision to reality.

Our scale offers the best of both worlds: the reach and stability of a national institution combined with the agility of a mid-sized organization, where contributions are visible and valued. You will be part of a diverse and inclusive community where authenticity is celebrated, collaboration is expected, and impact is shared - on learners, colleagues, and your own professional journey.

At Yorkville and Toronto Film School, your work does more than make a difference. It empowers others to achieve their potential, while giving you the opportunity to realize yours.

**Compensation philosophy**

At Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, we believe compensation should be fair, straightforward, and supportive of your growth. Our salary ranges reflect progression from learning in the role to excelling, with each offer based on skills, experience, and role complexity.

This position offers a minimum annual salary of $90,000 a midpoint of $100,000, and a maximum of $110,000. Established hires typically start near the midpoint, while the upper range is reserved for those with deep expertise and sustained contributions. Offers below the midpoint recognize strong potential with room to grow.

We strive for equitable, consistent pay, though rates may vary within the same role based on performance, specialized knowledge, and impact.

We welcome conversations about compensation throughout the hiring process.

**Join us**

We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have 70% of the qualifications we seek, express your interest.

**What you can expect from our hiring process:**

* A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
* An in-person interview with the Hiring Manager and a cross-functional team member, focused on your technical skills, hands-on infrastructure experience, problem-solving approach, and ability to work effectively in an evolving operational environment.
* A final interview with the CIO and a member of the Director, People HQ, focused on your technical experience, overall alignment with the organization, and working style.

Diversity, equity and inclusion are a critical component of life at Yorkville University and Toronto Film School and we are committed to making these values an integral part of our culture. We encourage applications from all qualified applicants, including women, persons with disabilities, Black, Indigenous and People of Colour (BIPOC), people from the Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Transsexual, Queer, Questioning, Two-Spirit, Intersex, Asexual + (LGBTQ2SIA+) community and other equity-seeking groups.

Title: Network Operations Manager
Description:
**About Us**
Effortless Office partners with our customers to make IT effortless so they can focus on their business. As a Hybrid Managed Services Provider (MSP) with a focus on providing world-class customer experience, we deliver and fully support secure cloud solutions as well as comprehensive managed IT and network services.
  
  
**About The Role**
Effortless is looking for a Network Operations Manager who is an excellent leader and engineer. This is a player-coach role: you will lead our network engineering team while remaining one of the company's top escalation and design resources for enterprise, high-availability, multi-platform networks.
  
  
You will own the health, security, and continuous improvement of the networks we manage for our customers and within our own Switch data center infrastructure. We expect you to be proactive: you will not wait for tickets. You and your team will regularly review client environments, find risk, capacity, and performance gaps before they become outages, and bring clear, cost-effective recommendations to our customers and Service Delivery Teams.
  
  
The ideal candidate has served as a Senior Network Engineer, has the technical depth to earn the respect of senior engineers, and has the leadership skills to develop them. You set a high standard, communicate clearly, take ownership, and care about the customer experience.
  
  
**Position Details**
**Reports to:**
President
  
  
**Direct reports:**
Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers
  
  
**Location:**
Remote with a preference for someone in/near Las Vegas, NV.
  
  
**Travel:**
Some travel required for data center work, client site visits, and special projects.
  
  
**Schedule:**
Monday - Friday 8:00-5:00 PST, with 24/7 escalation availability for major incidents and management of the team's on-call rotation.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401K + employer match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Opportunities for career growth and development
* Training and certification support

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Serves as the company's senior network engineering authority and final escalation point in core routing and switching, network security, and network diagnostics.
* Designs, reviews, and approves complex network configurations and architecture, including hardware and software technology, site locations, business continuity, disaster recovery, and integration of technologies.
* Personally assesses and resolves the most complex data network problems and incidents, and leads major incident response through to resolution and root cause analysis.
* Owns the design, standards, and lifecycle of Effortless's own network infrastructure at our Switch data centers, including Cisco Nexus, Firepower, and SDWAN (Meraki and Cisco Viptela) environments.
* Sets and maintains network engineering standards, configuration baselines, and documentation requirements in IT Glue, and reviews the team's work for quality and consistency.
* Reviews analyses and technical feasibility to develop data network deployment strategies, resource requirements, and cost estimates.

Proactive Client Improvement
  
  

* Leads a regular program of proactive network reviews across client environments to find security, reliability, capacity, and performance gaps before they cause issues.
* Uses Auvik monitoring, ticket trends in Autotask, and assessment data to identify recurring problems and drive permanent fixes rather than repeated reactive work.
* Assesses data network growth forecasts and ensures business needs are translated into network capacity requirements.
* Partners with Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, and ESAs to turn findings into clear, cost-effective recommendations for each client's technology roadmap.
* Tracks hardware and firmware end-of-life, vulnerabilities, and configuration drift across managed networks and plans remediation.
* Brings the customer's perspective to every recommendation: leads with business outcomes, not technology features.

Leadership
  
  

* Hires, onboards, coaches, and develops Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers, including technical mentoring and certification planning.
* Sets clear expectations, holds regular 1-on-1s, conducts performance reviews, and holds the team accountable using EOS tools (Rocks, Scorecards, Issues, To-Dos) in Strety.
* Manages team workload, project priorities, and resource availability, and plans and coordinates cross-functional or cross-company work.
* Owns network change management: reviews and approves changes, maintenance windows, and rollback plans.
* Manages the team's 24/7 on-call rotation and escalation process, and ensures after-hours coverage meets Effortless's service standards.
* Communicates status, risk, and outcomes clearly to leadership, Service Delivery Teams, and customers, following our CWC (Communicate, Work, Communicate) value.

Operations and Compliance
  
  

* Defines, tracks, and reports on network operations KPIs (see Success Measures below).
* Manages relationships with network vendors and carriers, including escalations, and supports procurement and licensing decisions.
* Ensures all compliance aspects of the position and team are known and followed; understands and complies with all policies, codes, and regulations applicable to the position and company, including client HIPAA, PCI, and NIST requirements.
* Maintains sensitive and confidential information regarding company and customer information.
* Performs related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
Education and Work Experience
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, or a related technical field
* 10+ years of experience with Service Provider, MSP, or enterprise networking or general telecommunications
* 3+ years in a Senior Network Engineer (or equivalent) role, serving as the top escalation and design resource for complex networks (required)
* 2+ years leading engineers as a manager, team lead, or technical lead, with direct responsibility for work assignment and mentoring
* MSP or multi-client environment experience strongly preferred

Specialized Knowledge and Skills
  
  

* Expert enterprise networking fundamentals, including complex switching and routing, high availability system design, advanced network security design, Internet services and protocols, and advanced network diagnostics.
* Demonstrated expert proficiency in at least three of the following, with advanced skills in the balance: core routing, core switching, network security, network diagnostics, and application load balancing.
* Top expert level analysis and design skills: gathering data on systems issues, defining alternative approaches, assessing business impact, and recommending, developing, and implementing cost-effective solutions.
* A track record of proactively finding and fixing problems in environments you support, with examples you can walk us through.
* Proven ability to lead, coach, and hold engineers accountable while staying hands-on.
* Excellent oral and written communication, including explaining technical risk and recommendations to non-technical customers and executives.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, incidents, and people concurrently.
* Advanced knowledge of current technologies, tools, applications, and vendors.

Certifications (preferred)
  
  

* CCNP Enterprise or Security, or equivalent experience; CCIE a strong plus
* Fortinet NSE, Meraki (CMNA/ECMS), or other vendor certifications
* ITIL Foundation or similar service management certification

Equipment and Applications
  
  

* Cisco Routers (ISR/ASR), Catalyst/Nexus Switches, Firepower and ASA Firewalls
* Cisco Viptela and Meraki SDWAN; Meraki Firewalls, Switches, and Wireless

At EO, our employees are what makes us special. We are a highly collaborative company with a very involved senior leadership team that invests in their staff. 398699

We are currently seeking a Data Center Network Service Delivery Manager to join our team in Austin, Texas (US-TX), United States (US).
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Data Center Network Service Delivery Manager is a designated Key Personnel leader holding overall accountability for the design, architecture, operations, security, and performance of enterprise data center network services under the customer's Data Center Services (DCS) program. Operating across the customer data center hubs, this role ensures fault-tolerant network failover paths, high bandwidth, Software-Defined Networking (SDN) fabric management, port aggregation, multi-factor token-based remote access solutions, and rigorous intrusion detection and prevention compliance.
  
  
Location: Hybrid onsite in Austin, TX.
  
  
Note: This is a notional position contingent upon contract award.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**LAN Support Services & Network Operations**

* Maintain network failover capabilities and fault-tolerant pathways to eliminate single points of failure, providing sufficient bandwidth to meet agreed service levels.
* Manage LAN technical support, administration, operations, and version control, including firmware/microcode updates, routing/switching devices, firewalls, and load balancers.

**Software-Defined Networking (SDN) & Policy Management**

* Continuously monitor and manage the enterprise Software-Defined Network (SDN) fabric across spine and leaf nodes, control planes, data planes, and multi-tenant endpoint groups.
* Enforce micro-segmentation zones isolating regulated data, simulate policy changes prior to deployment, and support Kubernetes network policies and GitOps workflows via structured formats (YAML, JSON, Terraform).
* Deploy atomic counters and latency measurements to provide east-west traffic visibility at the EPG pair level, integrating flow logs with the Security Operations SIEM.

**Remote Access, Port Aggregation & Security**

* Manage multi-factor token-based remote access solutions, digital certificates, and LDAP/federated authentication gateways enabling secure access for DIR Customers and Service Component Providers (SCPs).
* Oversee port aggregation services, providing DIR Customers with real-time application packet flows, physical/virtual tap management, and traffic forwarding to customer analysis tools.
* Install, configure, and operate centralized Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS), active blocking of malicious traffic, and real-time SIEM log integration with the Security Operations SCP.

**ITIL Governance, Monitoring & Multi-Vendor Collaboration**

* Enforce ITIL-aligned Incident, Problem, Change, Configuration, and Capacity Management processes in strict compliance with the Service Management Manual (SMM) and MSI tooling.

Title: Infrastructure Digital Delivery Lead
Location: Sharjah, Sharjah Emirate, United Arab Emirates
Description:
**Job Description**
**What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?**
At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
  
  
WSP are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Digital Delivery Lead to drive digital transformation, BIM excellence, automation initiatives, and digital project delivery across our Transport & Infrastructure business.
  
  
The Infrastructure Digital Delivery Lead is the strategic technology architect responsible for the comprehensive digital lifecycle of our major infrastructure, utility corridors, bridges, and infrastructure master plans. Operating across the entire delivery continuum from conceptual design to asset handover this role unifies BIM, Geospatial Intelligence (GIS), Real-time Digital Twins, Legacy CAD standardizations, High-End 3D Visualizations, and AI-driven workflow automations.
  
  
You will not just manage models; you will design the overarching data infrastructure that connects engineering design to operational asset management, ensuring absolute data integrity, efficiency, and future-proof project delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities & Duties**

* Digital Strategy, Frameworks & BIM Governance
* Author, maintain, and enforce the overarching Digital Delivery Execution Plan (DDEP) and BIM Execution Plans (BEP) in strict compliance with ISO 19650 standards.
* Establish, structure, and administer the Common Data Environment (CDE) using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360, setting up automated review workflows, ISO container compliance, and multi-firm security access permissions.
* Govern project coordinate systems, ensuring zero spatial or coordinate drift across linear highway alignments, utility networks, structural bridges, and global GIS maps.
* GIS & Digital Twin Integration
* Architect the bidirectional data pipelines connecting GIS platforms (Esri ArcGIS / QGIS) with horizontal engineering design software (Civil 3D / OpenRoads).
* Build the schema maps and asset metadata frameworks required to translate 3D BIM data into operational Digital Twin environments (e.g., Autodesk Tandem, Bentley iTwin, or custom web-based twin environments).
* Define asset tracking protocols to integrate future IoT sensor data metadata placeholders within the smart-city asset master list during the design phase.
* CAD Legacy & Hybrid Workflows
* Maintain strict quality control over traditional, two-dimensional deliverables by enforcing uniform CAD standards (layer structures, plot styles, sheet sets) alongside 3D environments.
* Manage hybrid workflows ensuring that legacy 2D drawings dynamically update from the core 3D federated model, minimizing manual drafting errors.
* 3D Visualization & Reality Capture
* Manage large-scale visual aggregation models within Autodesk InfraWorks, Twinmotion, or Unreal Engine to produce high-end, real-time interactive models for public consultation and executive stakeholder reviews.
* Oversite the integration of Reality Capture datasets (UAV Photogrammetry, LiDAR point clouds, mobile scanning) into active design environments for real-time site verification.
* AI Tools, Scripting & Automations
* Develop, scale, and deploy custom automations using Dynamo for Civil 3D/Revit, Python, or VBA to eliminate repetitive drafting tasks, automate grading calculations, and auto-populate asset metadata fields.
* Implement AI-driven design tools and generative design algorithms for optimizing massive earthworks volumes, alternative highway corridor alignments, and automated clash resolution pipelines.
* Utilize AI text and data analytics tools to run predictive automated audits on thousands of model parameters, catching quality drops instantly.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Information Management, Digital Engineering, or related discipline.
* Master's Degree would be advantageous
* Minimum 15 years of professional experience.
* Proven experience leading digital delivery on large-scale transport and infrastructure projects.
* Strong background supporting the design and delivery of:

+ Roads & Highways
+ Rail & Transit
+ Bridges and Structures
+ Utilities
+ Aviation
+ Smart Infrastructure Projects

* Demonstrated success in implementing BIM and digital transformation strategies within engineering consultancies.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary digital delivery teams.
* Experience working in the UAE and/or wider Middle East strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 19650 standards.

**Technical Proficiencies:**

* BIM / Civil Design: Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Civil 3D (corridors, pipes, gradings), InfraWorks, and Revit (structures/bridges).
* Geospatial (GIS): Expert capability in Esri ArcGIS (Pro / Online) and its native integrations with the Autodesk ecosystem.
* Digital Twin & Visualization: Practical understanding of Digital Twin schemas (Asset Information Models) and real-time rendering environments (InfraWorks, Enscape, Twinmotion).
* Automation & Coding: Proficient with Dynamo, Python, or visual programming tools. Experience with AI prompt engineering or AI plugins for design optimization is highly valued.
* Collaboration & CAD: Mastery of Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) alongside classic AutoCAD Architecture/Civil workflows.

You will join a cohesive, proficient team committed to upholding the highest standards of professionalism and technical expertise, directly contributing to the safety and security of the U.S. digital ecosystem.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
- Incident Command: Lead the end-to-end response for high-severity incidents, driving rapid restoration of service while coordinating across cross-functional engineering teams.
  
- Stakeholder Communication: Craft and deliver clear, timely, and accurate communication updates to internal stakeholders, executive leadership, and customer-facing teams during critical events.
  
- Post-Incident Reviews: Facilitate blameless post-mortems, ensuring root causes are thoroughly identified, actionable remediation items are tracked, and lessons learned are shared globally.
  
- Dashboarding & Visibility: Create and maintain real-time operational dashboards that provide high visibility into system health, incident trends, and key reliability metrics (MTTD/MTTR).
  
- Continuous Improvement: Analyze incident data and operational metrics to identify systemic trends, driving initiatives to reduce Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR).
  
- Team Process Evolution: Manage and optimize the incident management rotation, refining playbooks, alerting thresholds, and escalation pathways for the SRE org.
  
- Alerting & Monitoring Improvements: Partner with SRE and development teams to continuously refine alert thresholds, reduce alert fatigue, and ensure high-severity pages are highly actionable.
  
- Automation Engineering: Design and build automated workflows to streamline incident response, such as automated stakeholder communications, auto-remediation scripts, and tool integrations.
  
- Oncall Support: The Incident Management team operates 24x5x365 with on-call rotation during weekends. This position is for the Sunday to Thursday shift, from 5 PM PT to 2 AM PT.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications
  
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience) with 4+ years of experience in Incident Management, Production Support, or SRE/Operations within a large-scale SaaS or cloud environment.
  
- Strong understanding of cloud computing concepts (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and modern infrastructure architectures (microservices, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines).
  
- Hands-on experience configuring and refining alerts and monitoring templates using industry-standard tools (e.g., Grafana, Splunk, Prometheus, New Relic).
  
- Ability to write scripts (e.g., Bash, Python) or use low-code integration tools to automate repetitive incident management tasks and notification pipelines.
  
- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a track record of translating deeply technical issues into clear business impact summaries for leadership.
  
- Strong working knowledge of ITIL incident management frameworks or modern DevOps/SRE incident response practices.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
- 5+ years of experience in Incident Management, Production Support, or SRE/Operations within a large-scale SaaS or cloud environment.
  
- Deep alignment with Google SRE principles, including Error Budgets, SLA/SLO/SLI management, and automation-first mindsets.
  
- Proven experience implementing ChatOps, auto-remediation workflows, or Event-Driven Ansible/Runbook automation to programmatically resolve common alerts.
  
- Advanced proficiency with modern incident orchestration platforms like PagerDuty, Opsgenie, JIRA Service Management, and Slack integrations.
  
- Experience using SQL, Tableau, or similar data visualization tools to build operational dashboards and report on organizational reliability metrics.
  
- Relevant industry certifications such as ITIL v4, AWS/GCP Certified Professional, or Certified Incident Commander.
  
- Experience coaching and training engineering teams on best practices for on-call hygiene and conducting constructive post-mortems.

Title: Manager, IT Infrastructure Center of Excellence
Manager Data Center Operations
Description:
**Manager Data Center Operations**

**Your role**

The Manager Data Center Operationsis responsible for overseeing the execution of local data center operations at one or more data center properties. Data center operations include, but are not limited to:

* Engineering operations and core infrastructure maintenance
* Data center construction management, commissioning and start-up
* Delivery of data center services including colocation, connectivity, raised floor services and deployment
* Installation and management of all cable and network infrastructure supporting facility and customer connectivity
* Technical event management including post-event root cause analysis and infrastructure repair

**What you’ll do**

* Execute all aspects of data center operations including the operation, maintenance and repair of all mission critical equipment and systems supporting a 24x7 data center operation to achieve 100% uptime and 100% compliance with all customer SLAs.
* Supervises all construction activity and installations, in coordination with internal and external construction resources, to ensure system design, installation and testing adhere to operational standards.
* Witness testing of all equipment during commissioning and validate sequence of operations and receipt of all operational documentation.
* Manages provisioning of data center services including colocation, connectivity, raised floor services, deployment and any additional services to be delivered to data center customers.
* Manages all local customer installations, in coordination with Sales Engineering, Design & Construction and Colocation Operations to coordinate customer move-ins and turn-ups, including deployments, power circuit installations and connectivity requirements.
* Oversees local installation, maintenance and repair of all network infrastructure supporting all Digital Realty and customer connectivity in coordination with internal IT and network personnel.
* Supervise local engineering team to ensure adherence to standard operating procedures, sequence of operations and maintenance standards to guarantee execution of Digital Realty’s periodic maintenance program and maintenance calendar.
* Develop, implement and audit local standard operating procedures, sequence of operations and maintenance standards to be in compliance with Digital Realty’s standards and industry best practices.
* Supervise local change management processes including the review and approval of all Method of Procedures (MOPs) for maintenance and one-time/emergency repair events in coordination with onsite personnel, contractors and customers.
* Manage all maintenance and repair contracts to ensure compliance with maintenance standards and operational requirements. Confirm all vendors are qualified and adhere to Digital Realty’s performance standards and scopes of work.
* Responsible for timely execution of data center services such as remote hands, customer installations and service requests.
* Supervise security personnel and manage security systems including the adherence to security policies and compliance programs (as required by the Property Manager)
* Act as primary technical and operational contact for data center customers – both as the technical lead and local point of escalation during emergency events and day to day operations. Develop knowledge of customer’s core business and the business function of the customer’s local datacenter operation.
* Manage technical and operational incidents at the property, including the implementation of emergency response procedures, resource coordination, customer communication, root-cause analysis and post event remediation.
* Identify trends and analyze risks to articulate implications and impact to data center operations. Track operational metrics and other data to provide Senior Management oversight and control for both snapshot data and long-term trend analysis.
* Identify process based improvements that generate operational and financial efficiencies including the development and presentation of the business case.
* Support Property Manager with the management of expenses and assist all budgeting, forecasting and reporting requirements by providing capital and expense requirements and justifications.
* Support pre-sales process, including, but not limited to, conducting sales tours and reviewing lease proposals and lease agreements to confirm compliance with Digital Realty standards and local requirements.
* Support various accreditation initiatives, including, but not limited to, SSAE16, SOC2, ISO 27001, etc. as may be required by Digital Realty.
* Maintain compliance with local health & safety (i.e. OSHA) standards and national electrical and building codes.

**What you’ll need**

* 10 years related facility management experience in data center operations (or related electrical or mechanical engineering field) with minimum of 5 years’ experience managing or leading data center operations teams in a large scale mission critical environment. Bachelor’s degree in electrical or mechanical engineering preferred.
* Solid and proven experience in the construction, commissioning, acceptance and operation of mission critical systems, including state-of-the-art electrical distribution systems, static and rotary UPS, emergency standby generation, fire alarm/suppression and monitoring systems
* Extensive knowledge of structured cabling systems, networking and connectivity standards, and hardware installation requirements.
* Proficient experience in colocation operations, including the installation and deployment of cage, rack and cable infrastructure, as well as, power circuit installation and power monitoring.
* Experience working with and deploying telecom and network providers, specifically in Meet Me Room and POP room environments
* Experience managing a change control environment
* Strong quantitative and qualitative reasoning skills, with demonstrated ability to determine event root causes, performance shortfalls and required corrective actions.
* Knowledge of industry data center standards, policies & methodologies
* Knowledge of performance management & critical awareness methods and implementation standards
* Strong interpersonal, presentation and communication skills
* Strong organizational skills and detail oriented
* Experience managing own budget and analyzing expenses
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook and familiarity with Microsoft Project, Visio or AutoCad
* Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM), and power metering system

**A bit about us**

Digital Realty brings companies and data together by delivering the full spectrum of data center, colocation and interconnection solutions. PlatformDIGITAL®, the company’s global data center platform, provides customers with a secure data meeting place and a proven Pervasive Datacenter Architecture (PDx®) solution methodology for powering innovation and efficiently managing Data Gravity challenges. Digital Realty gives its customers access to the connected data communities that matter to them with a global data center footprint of 300+ facilities in 50+ metros across 25+ countries on six continents.

  

**Operations**

Our Operations team keeps our customers’ infrastructure running safely and securely. We get plenty of opportunities to take on a variety of tasks and develop our technical skills. From overseeing electrical power to cooling and fire suppression systems, our team plays a vital role in making sure everything in our data centers operates as it should.

  

**What we can offer you**

Our rapidly evolving business sector offers the opportunity to be part of a courageous and passionate team who work together to understand and meet the changing needs of our global customers.

  

Join us and you’ll be part of a supportive and inclusive environment where you can bring your whole self to work. As part of our team, you’ll get to work with people from different business areas, challenge the way we do things and put your ideas into action. We’ll also give you plenty of development opportunities so you can build a rewarding and successful career with us.

  

Apply today, take charge of your career and grow your talents with us.

  

**Health and Safety**

Safety isn't just a priority here at Digital; it's critical to everything we do. Safeguarding lives, protecting assets, and securing data aren't just ideals - they're essential pillars of our commitment to excellence for our people, our partners and our customers. We have a culture of care where every member of Team Digital embraces a relentless pursuit of working safely across Digital Realty. Together we are Safely Powering Progress.

  

**Our Compensation Philosophy**

Digital Realty offers its employees a highly competitive compensation package, excellent benefits, and an environment that recognizes and rewards your contributions. Central to our compensation philosophy is rewarding our employees for achieving the values and objectives aligned to the company's overall goals and values.

Title: Oracle Service Delivery Manager
Description:
**About Centroid**
Centroid helps organizations modernize, operate, and support mission-critical business systems across Oracle and multi-cloud environments. We provide advisory, deployment, migration, integration, and managed services, with a focus on strong client service, dependable delivery, and career growth for our employees.
  
  
Travel: up to 10%
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Centroid is seeking a Service Delivery Manager (SDM) to lead assigned Cloud Managed Services accounts. This role is responsible for client satisfaction, service quality, account health, financial performance, and responsible growth. The SDM serves as the primary service management contact for clients and works closely with technical teams, leadership, and internal stakeholders to keep delivery aligned with scope, service commitments, and client expectations.
  
  
This is a client-facing delivery leadership role, not a hands-on technical administration role. The ideal candidate is organized, accountable, comfortable working through matrixed global teams, and able to manage priorities, risks, escalations, and follow-through in a fast-paced managed services environment.
  
  
What We’re Looking For
  
  
Success in this role requires more than experience. We are looking for candidates who can share real examples that demonstrate the following traits:
  
  

* Flexibility: Adapts quickly when priorities, client needs, or delivery constraints change.
* Process-driven and organized: Uses structure, follow-up routines, and clear communication to keep work moving.
* Intrinsically motivated: Takes initiative, follows through, and looks for ways to improve outcomes.
* Interested in learning and growing: Is coachable, curious, and open to learning Centroid’s way of working.
* Accountable: Owns commitments, raises risks early, and closes the loop with clients and internal teams.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Client Leadership and Account Health
  
  

* Lead the overall health of assigned Cloud Managed Services accounts, including client satisfaction, retention, service quality, profitability, and responsible growth.
* Run the regular client and internal cadence, including monthly reviews, QBRs, risk reviews, decision tracking, and follow-up actions.
* Communicate performance, risks, recommendations, and improvement opportunities clearly to client and Centroid leadership.

Service Delivery and Governance
  
  

* Oversee service delivery across assigned accounts, technologies, and global teams while staying within SOWs, SLAs, procedures, and Centroid standards.
* Set up practical account governance, including meeting cadence, reporting, escalation paths, roles, responsibilities, and decision processes.
* Coordinate with technical, service desk, security, consulting, vendor, and leadership teams to keep work moving and handoffs clear.

Service Operations, Transitions, and Escalations
  
  

* Lead coordination and client communication during incidents, escalations, outages, maintenance windows, production changes, and other high-priority situations.
* Keep ownership clear, drive the communication rhythm, confirm recovery, and make sure RCA and corrective actions are completed.
* Support transitions into Cloud Managed Services by confirming scope, SLAs, resources, access, documentation, knowledge transfer, monitoring, ticket routing, and readiness.

Financial Management
  
  

* Manage account financial health, including budget, revenue, margin, utilization, forecasting, billing readiness, and financial risk.
* Watch demand and scope, identify out-of-scope work early, and support change orders, renewals, profitability improvements, and account planning.

Resource Leadership
  
  

* Lead onshore and offshore delivery teams supporting 24x7 operations while partnering with technical managers who own direct people management.
* Plan for capacity, identify coverage or skill gaps, coordinate assignments, improve handoffs, and coach teams on communication, documentation, escalation, and follow-through.

Security, Compliance, and Operational Risk
  
  

* Ensure assigned accounts follow Centroid’s security, privacy, access-management, audit, data-handling, and compliance requirements.
* Track evidence and follow-up for access approvals, onboarding, offboarding, controls, audit requests, security findings, patching needs, and other risks.

Reporting, Continuous Improvement, and Growth
  
  

* Provide clear reporting on SLAs, ticket trends, incidents, changes, availability, risks, projects, utilization, financials, and improvement actions.
* Use service data to spot recurring issues, process gaps, automation opportunities, and practical service improvements.
* Partner with Sales, Consulting, solution architects, and leadership on renewals, proposals, service expansion, and opportunities that create client value.

Additional Expectations
  
  
This is a remote position with limited travel. The SDM must be able to support client escalations, global team coordination, maintenance windows, and time-sensitive issues across time zones.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 10+ years of enterprise IT or technology services experience, including 3 to 5 years leading service delivery, client accounts, operations, projects, or matrixed teams.
* Experience managing multiple client accounts, SLA-based services, ITSM processes, governance, escalations, financials, utilization, scope, reporting, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders and manage customer-facing service-delivery work.
* Strong communication, facilitation, negotiation, conflict-resolution, organization, and prioritization skills.
* Ability to turn complex technical and operational information into clear business communication and action plans.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL Foundation or higher; PMP, Certified ScrumMaster, or another service or project management credential is helpful.
* Experience with a Managed Services Provider supporting 24x7 enterprise operations and Oracle application, database, integration, infrastructure, or engineered-system services.
* Working knowledge of OCI, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, hybrid environments, monitoring, patching, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, security, and identity and access management.
* Familiarity with HaloPSA, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, OpenAir, or similar platforms, plus experience with executive reviews, renewals, and service-growth opportunities.

Why Join Centroid
  
  
At Centroid, you will work with experienced teams, support meaningful client outcomes, and grow your career in a collaborative Cloud Managed Services environment. This role offers the opportunity to lead important client relationships, strengthen delivery practices, and make a visible impact across clients and internal teams.

Title: Service Delivery Manager - Infrastructure Operations, Workload Automation & Incident Response
Description:
**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
Position Overview
  
  

* The Delivery Manager is responsible for leading managed infrastructure and workload automation services across multiple technology disciplines. This role provides operational leadership for Workload Automation and the Incident Response Team (IRT), a first-level Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) function responsible for monitoring, triage, incident response, technical coordination and service restoration across supported environments.
* The role requires a strong working knowledge of enterprise infrastructure and workload automation technologies, including Control-M, AutoSys, Tivoli and other applicable workload automation platforms, Windows, Linux, backup and restore, storage, databases, and cloud platforms such as OCI, AWS and Microsoft Azure. The individual must be able to effectively lead technical teams, manage operational risks and escalations, and communicate technical issues and business impact to clients and stakeholders.
* Automation is a core component of this role. The successful candidate should have demonstrated experience identifying opportunities to automate repeatable operational activities, reduce manual intervention, improve reliability and drive measurable improvements in service delivery.
* The ideal candidate should enjoy working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, exercise sound business judgment, and apply strong problem-solving and collaboration skills across a complex organization.
* Recruit, develop, inspire and retain a high-performing operations and engineering team while promoting accountability, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Business and Industry Skills
  
  

* Demonstrates working knowledge across infrastructure operations, workload automation, SRE practices and managed services delivery. Stays current with relevant IT infrastructure, cloud, automation and service-management technologies, ITIL practices and vendor offerings.
* Communicates in an open, candid, clear, complete and consistent manner. Listens well, conveys technical and business information in easily understood formats, and demonstrates professionalism in formal and informal interactions.
* Understands the meaning and implications of key operational and financial indicators and uses data to identify issues, evaluate service performance and develop practical improvement plans.
* Collaborates effectively across technology towers, client teams, account leadership, engineering teams and third-party suppliers to drive service outcomes.

Responsibilities
  
  
**Managed Service Delivery**

* Manage day-to-day delivery of infrastructure, workload automation and Incident Response Team services.
* Ensure achievement of SLA, KPI, availability, quality and operational performance objectives.
* Provide leadership during service-impacting incidents and escalations, ensuring the appropriate technical resources and stakeholders are engaged.
* Drive operational accountability across technology teams and ensure issues are followed through to resolution.
* Identify recurring operational issues and partner with engineering teams to implement permanent corrective actions.
* Maintain appropriate staffing, skills, coverage, documentation and operational readiness across supported services.
* Manage relationships with clients, internal stakeholders, technology partners and third-party suppliers.
* Validate that staffing levels, skill levels and other resources align with contractual, financial and solution requirements.
* Identify resource or capability gaps and document associated risks, mitigation plans and contingencies.

**Incident Response / SRE Operations**

* Provide leadership for the Incident Response Team, supporting first and second-level SRE and infrastructure operations.
* Ensure effective monitoring, event management, incident triage, escalation, troubleshooting and service-restoration processes.
* Coordinate support across Windows, Linux, backup and restore, storage, database, cloud and other infrastructure technologies.
* Promote proactive operations by identifying repeat incidents, alert noise, manual activities and opportunities for improved monitoring and automation.

Title: Senior Program Manager, Network Build
Description:
**Brief Description**
Senior Program Manager, Network Build
  
  
**HELP CONNECT ARIZONA. BUILD THE FUTURE OF BROADBAND**
.
  
  
At Wecom Fiber, we're helping bridge the digital divide across Arizona by building and maintaining the communications infrastructure that powers homes, businesses, schools, and communities.
  
  
**WHY WECOM?**
At Wecom, we believe exceptional people deserve more than a paycheck.
  
  
We're building a workplace where employees can grow their careers, make an impact, and help shape the future of telecommunications across Arizona. Our employees are helping connect communities, expand broadband access, and bring meaningful technology infrastructure to underserved areas throughout the state.
  
  
**Department:**
Enterprise Program Management
  
  
**Reports to:**
Senior Director of Enterprise Program Management
  
  
**Location:**
Arizona – Statewide (Field/Hybrid)
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Senior Program Manager, Network Build leads the delivery of fiber network construction across one or more markets and the Design Areas within them. This role owns the plan for each market from an accepted design package through an operational network, and is accountable for keeping every Design Area moving through the same sixteen milestones, from package accepted to operational. The Senior Program Manager sets the standard for how the Network Build Program Managers plan, report and escalate, and is the primary voice of the build program to senior leaders. The role also helps build and refine the processes the team runs on, so that planning, handoffs, reporting and vendor payment become more consistent and more efficient as the program grows.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Plan and schedule ownership**

* Own the schedule and plan logic for assigned markets, including dependencies, crew capacity, quantities, production rates and weather effects, and keep them accurate as work moves from Project Controls to the Network Build team.
* Maintain the sixteen-milestone plan for every Design Area, and decide when a milestone is complete using evidence from the responsible team rather than assumption.
* Re-forecast dates when crew counts, weather, permits or materials change, and explain the effect on the market finish date.

**Milestone management and handoffs**

* Confirm the Operational state of each Design Area. The Senior Program Manager and the Network Build Program Managers confirm it; no other team does.
* Manage the release of each project to construction, including the handoff to Supply Chain for materials staging and the notice to Sales and Marketing.
* In Prescott, run the pre-construction approval sequence: Construction completes the utility locates and reports to the Program Manager, the Program Manager schedules the pre-construction walks, Design and Engineering makes comments and corrections, the City approves, and Construction is then released.

**Cross-functional leadership**

* Coordinate Design and Engineering, the Permit Specialist, Supply Chain, Construction, Sales and Marketing and the Network Operations Center so that each handoff is clean and dated.
* Hold a weekly meeting with each team on Thursday or Friday, collect final updates by Monday, and prepare the reports for the Wednesday 30-60-90 day review.
* Escalate risks, delays and decisions early, with a recommendation and the effect on schedule and cost.

**Vendor and financial oversight**

* Make sure construction vendors are paid accurately and on time by reviewing each submitted invoice against the approved design prints before it is entered for payment.
* Track budget against forecast for each Design Area and flag variances to leadership.

**Reporting and governance**

* Report status using four labels: On Track, At-Risk, Off-Track and Complete.
* Track grant-funded markets against their commitments and prepare the reporting those programs require.
* Review the plan data for accuracy each week, and correct gaps before reports are issued.
* Communicate directly with executives and senior leaders in writing and in meetings, presenting status, risks, decisions and recommendations in plain language with the conclusion first.

**Team leadership**

* Coach and review the work of the Network Build Program Managers, set consistent reporting standards, and step in on the most complex or at-risk markets.

**Process development and improvement**

* Help design and document the processes the Network Build team follows, including milestone definitions, handoffs between teams, schedule updates, reporting and vendor invoice review.
* Review how the processes work in practice each quarter, identify recurring delays, rework and gaps, and recommend and lead improvements.
* Turn lessons from completed Design Areas into updated standards, templates and checklists that every Network Build Program Manager uses.
* Work with Design and Engineering, Permitting, Supply Chain, Construction, Sales and Marketing and the Network Operations Center to agree on process changes before they are adopted.
* Train and coach the Network Build Program Managers on new and revised processes, and confirm that they are followed.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* A bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, business or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* At least eight years of program or project management experience, including at least five years delivering outside plant fiber, utility or telecommunications construction.
* Demonstrated ability to manage schedules with dependencies, crew capacity and weather, and to explain a forecast change in plain language.
* Experience managing construction vendors, including invoice review against design documents.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing and presenting executive-level status reports, briefings and recommendations that are clear, accurate and concise.

**Preferred**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent.
* Experience with federal or state broadband grant programs.
* Experience with permitting for rights-of-way, railroad, highway and utility pole attachments.
* Experience leading or mentoring other program managers.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Every Design Area in the assigned markets shows an accurate, current date for each milestone.
* Forecast dates move when crews, weather or permits change, and leaders hear about the change before the weekly review.
* Vendor invoices are verified against the design prints and paid without rework.
* Handoffs between teams happen on the planned date, with no team waiting for another.
* Processes are documented, current and followed, and improvements that came from completed Design Areas are visible in the team's standards and templates.

**The Benefits Of Joining Our Team**
**Career Growth & Leadership Opportunity**

* Influence operational strategy
* Build scalable systems and processes
* Lead transformational initiatives
* Partner with executive leadership
* Support expansion into new markets
* Shape the future of construction management at Wecom

**Comprehensive Benefits & Total Rewards**
**Health & Well-Being**

* Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage
* Supplemental Benefit Options
* Life & Disability Insurance
* Employee Assistance Resources
* Gym Reimbursement up to $600 annually

**Time Away from Work**

* Paid Weekly
* PTO Accrual Begins Immediately with No Waiting Period
* 13 Company-Paid Holidays Annually

**Financial Wellness**

* 401(k) with Company Match up to 5%

**Additional Perks**

* Cell Phone Reimbursement up to $50 per month
* Annual Boot Reimbursement up to $150 (field positions)
* Ongoing Leadership Training

**TEAM-ORIENTED CULTURE**
We've built a culture where employees are respected, supported, and empowered to succeed. We value collaboration, accountability, innovation, continuous improvement, professional growth, and recognition.
  
  
**BUILD SOMETHING BIGGER**
Join Wecom and help build the infrastructure connecting Arizona's communities today and for generations to come.
